title: Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer
description:
Join a project that’s not just exciting—it’s world-changing! We’re looking for talented individuals to be part of something truly remarkable. If you’re driven by challenge and the chance to make a lasting impact, this is the perfect place for you. Don’t just be a part of the future—help create it.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals, and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The immersion engineering team is looking for a Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer to strengthen the team. Immersion engineering is taking care of all calculations regarding tunnel elements float up (weight analysis, determine ballast concrete and water, longitudinal section forces, floating stability), transfers in basins and harbour (winch operations with or without vessel assistance), mooring of the tunnel elements, transport to offshore location, immersion (including but not limited to dynamic analyses) and the stability of the elements after immersion.

As the Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will coordinate and participate in the team responsible for floating up and/or hoisting the concrete tunnel elements, equipping them in the port and then transporting and installing them at sea. In a first phase you will participate in the preparation of this crucial operation, by making ballast plans e.g.. In a second phase, you will be part of the operational team that does the immersion work, by going offshore and assist the Immersion Master by giving technical advice. This is what you are prepared to do in Denmark (full time or in 4-2 rotation).

Main tasks and responsibilities:

• As Deputy Lead Immersion Engineer, you will focus on coordination of the tasks for the team and manage the stakeholders

• During the preparatory phase, you are responsible for the ballast plans and float up calculations.

• You take part in the interface management with other departments within FLC regarding specific parts of the T&I scope

• You will coordinate part of the design scope between Work Preparations and the design team based in the Netherlands and Belgium

• You are involved in the management/operation of Tunnel Control Systems

• You ensure the conclusions and results from the design documents are correctly taken over in the work method statements, drawings and operation manuals for the Immersion Pontoon specific operations related to the overall transport and immersion scope

• You liaise with the Marine Warranty Surveyor and contribute to the work procedures, Go/No Go procedures

• During float up and ballasting you check if operations stay within boundary conditions and act accordingly

• During the execution phase, you advise during the transport and installation of the elements. You will be present in the command unit of the immersion pontoons during offshore operations. You will do checks during execution, monitor the immersion process, and have an advisory role to the one in charge of the operation. You are also prepared and ready to deal with contingencies if any might occur

• After immersion, you will organize and do checks on data to create lessons learned for next operations

Qualifications:

• You are a qualified naval architect/maritime engineer/offshore engineer with minimum of 7 years experience

• You have prior experience with immersion of large structures or offshore lifting operations

• You have a good understanding of stability calculations, mooring calculations and hydrodynamics

• You are a hands-on problem solver and a decision maker

• You are a team player with strong communication skills

• You find it a challenge to work in a international, multi-cultural work-environment in which communication and team spirit is key to success

• You are fluent in English.

The FLC staff is expected to set themselves targets, achieve them independently, and take responsibility for their actions – irrespective of their position in the company.

Full time employment with health insurance and lunch arrangement available upon request.

title: Site Engineer, Mechanical for Renewables; Location: Denmark , DK - Esbjerg, DK - Aarhus, Worldwide
description:
If you are as passionate about sustainability and the green transition as we are, then this is a great opportunity for you to join an international company in growth as our new Site Engineer, Mechanical for our Renewables Division!
 
Your position 

As our new Site Engineer, Mechanical at Semco Maritime you will join an experienced, highly skilled and passionate team of engineers in our Renewables division. This team has been responsible for creating one of the largest project portfolios within offshore substations worldwide.

At Semco Maritime safety is a core value, and in this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering innovative solutions. Above all, your work will make a real change for the global energy sector. 
We are working on sites globally in our markets, including Europe, Asia and the USA. So, traveling work is the standard and we work both offshore and onshore.

Your tasks & responsibilities 

You will be involved in the construction of offshore substation for windfarms and distribution/transmission projects world-wide. You, together with your team will be responsible for installations, tests, and commissioning of mechanical systems such as ventilation systems, cooling systems, fire extinguishing system, diesel generator system and fuel system.

Your tasks will include but are not limited to: 

  • Coordinating and managing daily site activities for 4-10 skilled workers
  • Ensuring that the project activities adhere to the schedule and activities are planned accordingly
  • Coordinate and plan with installation suppliers / yard / partners
  • Purchase and overseeing the timely delivery of materials and coordination with vendors
  • Plan and align with Engineering department on changes in design and/or other topics
  • Ad-hoc daily tasks and problem solving
  • Run and manage start-up and commissioning of mechanical systems

Your profile & qualifications 

We imagine that you are an ambitious and talented professional with a keen eye for detail. You are also a dedicated team player with a positive attitude as well as good commercial awareness and managerial skills.
 
To succeed in this position, we expect that you:
  • Preferred to have a master’s or bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, marine engineering or similar
  • Have prior hands-on experience with some of the mechanical systems
  • Have experience working with staff and supplier contracts
  • Possess a safety-first mindset
  • Would like to work in an international setting where a lot of traveling is required to go to the sites
  • Have effective interpersonal skills and great communication skills in English

Welcome to Semco Maritime 
At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 
Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  
We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   
Care to join the movement? 

Change. With us.

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Senior Research Adviser for EU, International Funding, Innovation and Impact, Faculty of Health Sciences
description:
Are you curious about how FP10 will change the opportunities and requirements facing universities? Are you interested in the growing expectations for innovation and impact arising from research? And would you like to work both strategically and closely with researchers and projects, with one clear objective: to strengthen SUND’s international position and secure more external funding?

Then you could play a central role in SUND Research Support. We are looking for an experienced research adviser who from 1 December 2026 can serve as our key specialist for EU and international funding opportunities – and help prepare the unit for tomorrow’s requirements in relation to funding, project delivery, innovation and societal impact.

Responsibilities
You will take an overview of EU and international funding: from developments in Horizon Europe and FP10 to specific calls, partnerships and opportunities for SUND researchers. You will translate policy and programme developments into action and help us position ourselves early as new agendas emerge.

The role spans strategic intelligence and portfolio oversight through to hands-on advice and coordination of prioritised initiatives. Some days you will work on long-term EU positioning and pipeline development; on others, closely with a researcher, an international consortium or a specific call. We do not expect you to do everything yourself, but you will need to spot opportunities, bring together the right expertise and drive progress.

Innovation and impact are important parts of the role. You will strengthen our impact-upfront approach and ensure that requirements relating to involvement, uptake, implementation and knowledge valorisation are considered early. At the same time, you will contribute to a smooth transition from pre-award to post-award, so that project delivery is considered from the outset and lessons from funded projects and project implementation feed into new applications.

You will be both a key contributor to specific EU and international initiatives and a co-developer of our shared models, workflows and portfolio overview. The aim is a more coherent approach to international funding – not simply more individual applications.

Qualifications
We are looking for an experienced professional who thrives at the intersection of research, EU policy, funding, innovation and impact. You have solid experience of EU or international funding, research development or research support, and a good knowledge of Horizon Europe or other major international programmes.

You work strategically and analytically but are also keen to turn insight into tangible results. You are a strong coordinator and relationship-builder who can navigate complex processes, bring together expertise and build trust with researchers, colleagues and management. You communicate confidently in both Danish and English.
It is an advantage if you also have experience of areas such as EU policy, international consortia, Brussels networks, post-award, innovation, societal impact or knowledge valorisation. We do not expect you to be an expert in all of these areas. A PhD or other research experience may be an advantage but is not essential.

In addition, you have an understanding of and a desire to work with digitalization and artificial intelligence (AI) in relation to optimizing processes and creating value within the organization. 

About SUND Research Support and the Faculty of Health Sciences
SUND Research Support assists researchers at the Faculty of Health Sciences at SDU from the early idea and funding opportunity through to application, project delivery, innovation and impact.

We aim to work more proactively with funding intelligence, positioning, partnerships and long-term pipelines – and to create stronger links between pre-award, post-award, innovation and impact. At the same time, we want to use data, organisational learning and AI more systematically.

You will have the opportunity both to work directly with researchers and projects and to help shape how a modern research support function should operate in the years ahead. You will play a central role in SUND’s international funding activities in the run-up to FP10 and help create stronger links between EU/international funding, post-award, innovation and impact.

You will work closely with strong health sciences research environments, management teams and colleagues with a range of specialist profiles. We are interested in new ways of working and in how data, digital tools and AI can add value to research support. This is an opportunity both to deliver results today and to help shape how we work tomorrow.

The Faculty of Health Sciences at the University of Southern Denmark is one of Denmark’s leading faculties of health sciences. With nine departments, internationally top‑class research, and a broad range of health‑related study programmes, we contribute to developing the knowledge, treatments, and healthcare system of the future.
As an employee at the faculty, you become part of an ambitious and interdisciplinary environment characterised by high academic standards, strong collaborations, and excellent opportunities for professional development. The faculty has activities in Odense, Esbjerg, and Copenhagen. In Esbjerg and Copenhagen, strong academic communities provide the framework for research and education, while our modern faculty building in Odense brings research, education, and administration together under one roof and is directly connected to Odense University Hospital.

Read more about the Faculty of Health Sciences here.

Contact
If you would like more information about the position, you are welcome to contact head of SUND Research Support Anne Kathrine Overgaard, tlf. 60111043, e-mail: aovergaard@health.sdu.dk or Head of Education and Secretariat Merete Munk på mmunk@health.sdu.dk.

Application Process
The application deadline is 29 September 2026 at 11:59 PM. We expect to conduct interviews 7 October 2026. 

Employment starts on 1 December 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Salary and Terms of Employment
Your place of employment will be the University of Southern Denmark in Odense, Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M.

There may be limited travel activity to other SDU campus cities.

Employment is in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and collective agreement for academics (AC).

The position is full time.

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range of the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.
SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. 

If you are interested in the position, you must submit an application that includes a cover letter, CV indicating months and years (without photo), and diploma. All documents related to the application should not contain photos or CPR numbers – if so, the CPR number must be redacted.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. The cover letter and CV must not exceed 5 MB.

Guidance on the application process can be found here.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding society and therefore encourages all qualified applicants, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

About SDU
The University of Southern Denmark exists to create value for and with society. Whether our contribution comes in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education, or learning, we aim to make a positive difference for society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by nurturing talent and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops, and recruits talent. At the same time, we must ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. It is the university’s researchers, teachers, students, leaders, and technical-administrative staff who form the foundation of our success.

title: Paving Worker / Landscaping Construction Worker – Practical Skills

The position is suitable for candidates who have good practical skills, an aptitude for manual work and an interest in construction and outdoor work.

A formal vocational qualification as a paving worker or landscaper is not required.

What we offer

  • Fixed salary matched to your qualifications

title: Senior Software Engineer! Build production software – and raise the engineering bar around you
description:
If your definition of seniority is more than simply having written code for many years, this could be interesting.

Cubris develops software that helps rail operators run smarter, safer and more sustainable railway services.

As part of Hitachi Rail, we are now strengthening our engineering organisation and developing Cubris into a high-performing technology competence centre around our GreenSpeed® platform.

We are therefore looking for a Senior Software Engineer who combines strong hands-on development skills with technical ownership.

This is not a role where you receive a Jira ticket, implement it and move on.

You will take ownership of delivery within a product area – from understanding requirements and making implementation decisions to coordinating development, identifying risks and getting robust software into production.

What you will do

You will:

  • Design, develop and ship production-grade software

  • Translate requirements into clear technical tasks and solutions

  • Take ownership of technical execution within a product area

  • Coordinate development across multiple engineers when required

  • Identify dependencies, blockers and technical risks before they affect delivery

  • Challenge unclear requirements constructively

  • Participate actively in design discussions and technical reviews

  • Design and document architecture at component level

  • Develop and maintain release pipelines

  • Work closely with Product and Quality Engineering

  • Support colleagues through technical sparring, reviews and coaching

  • Improve code quality, testability, maintainability and delivery practices

The role is deliberately broader than coding alone. Cubris expects senior engineers to take responsibility for outcomes, not just assigned tasks.

What you bring

We are looking for substantial software engineering experience and a strong track record of taking software from requirements into production.

Your technical foundation should include:

  • Strong C#/.NET experience

  • Docker/container experience

  • Azure DevOps Cloud

  • Solid software design fundamentals

  • Testing and code-quality practices

  • CI/CD and modern delivery workflows

  • Debugging and performance thinking

  • Database and data-access experience

Experience with .NET MAUI, Blazor, Android/device-based UI or embedded UI solutions is relevant for parts of the GreenSpeed® environment and would be an advantage.

But technical skills alone are not enough.

You should also be comfortable creating momentum when requirements are ambiguous, making sound engineering decisions and helping other developers become better. The formal role description specifically calls for experience leading technical initiatives without necessarily having formal people-management responsibility.

Why Cubris?

You join at a point where your experience can make a visible difference.

You will work close to Product, Quality Engineering and experienced technical colleagues while helping define the standards, tools and engineering practices of the organisation Cubris is becoming.

You get:

  • A technically meaningful product

  • Direct influence on engineering decisions

  • A focused Danish technology environment

  • International reach through Hitachi Rail

  • The opportunity to help build the engineering culture rather than simply become part of an established one

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Company: Cubris – a Hitachi Rail company

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Tech Lead! 50% Lead Developer. 50% Software Architect. 100% technical leadership.
description:
Are you the engineer people turn to when the code is difficult, the architecture matters and the team needs a technical direction?

Cubris is strengthening its engineering organisation around GreenSpeed® as part of our ambition to build a high-performing technology competence centre for intelligent railway solutions within Hitachi Rail.

We are looking for a Tech Lead who combines deep hands-on software engineering with architectural judgement.

This is deliberately not a traditional management role.

You will spend approximately 50% of your time as a Lead Developer and 50% as a Software Architect – building production software, solving difficult engineering problems and coaching developers while also representing your team in the Architecture Group and translating architectural direction into practical solutions.

Your role as Lead Developer

You will:

  • Write and ship production code

  • Take ownership of technically complex stories

  • Unblock other engineers when problems become difficult

  • Coach developers through pairing, design discussions and high-quality PR reviews

  • Raise standards for automated testing and CI/CD

  • Improve pipeline reliability and engineering effectiveness

  • Strengthen observability through logs, metrics and traces

  • Drive systematic reduction of technical debt

  • Establish useful patterns, runbooks and reference implementations

In other words: you are expected to remain technically credible because you are still doing the work.

Your role as Software Architect

At the same time, you will:

  • Represent your team in Cubris’ Architecture Group

  • Translate architectural decisions and ADRs into practical team standards

  • Define service boundaries, APIs, events and data contracts

  • Establish and verify non-functional requirements around security, reliability, performance and cost

  • Lead technical migrations and integrations

  • Manage architectural dependencies and compatibility

  • Maintain architectural documentation, roadmaps and decision records

You become the technical bridge between Product, Engineering and Architecture.

What you bring

We expect you to have:

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience

  • Experience leading technical initiatives or engineering teams

  • Strong C#/.NET expertise

  • Experience designing distributed systems and/or microservices

  • Good SQL/NoSQL fundamentals

  • Experience with APIs, domain modelling and event-driven architectures

  • Strong understanding of CI/CD and modern software delivery

  • Experience with cloud technologies, containers and orchestration

  • An engineering mindset around reliability, observability, security and performance

  • The ability to mentor developers and communicate technical decisions clearly

The current environment includes C#/.NET, .NET Core, Entity Framework, MS SQL Server, Azure DevOps, Git, CI/CD and Visual Studio, with Azure, Kubernetes and Infrastructure-as-Code increasingly relevant.

Why Cubris?

Because you will have unusually visible technical influence.

You will not simply inherit somebody else's engineering system. You will help define how Cubris builds software: the architecture, engineering practices, quality standards and technical guardrails that enable the organisation to scale.

And the software has a tangible purpose: helping make modern railway operations smarter, more predictable and more energy-efficient.

Location: Ballerup, Denmark
Department: Software Production
Reports to: Development Manager

Interested?

Reach out for an informal and confidential conversation.

Please note that work permit needs to be in place before applying and that there is no relocation package included. You must be able to commute to the office in Ballerup every work day.

title: Chef- Zoku Copenhagen
description:
Are you a passionate chef with great cooking skills who loves to work in an open kitchen? Then keep reading.

Zoku provides a home for business travellers who want to live in a city for between a few days and a few months. We’re a new type of hotel offering a relaxed place to live, co-work and socialize – while wiring residents into the local scene. Join an international team of driven, proactive and fun-loving Zokus who all have one thing in common: a passion for connecting people across the globe.

TELL ME MORE

Life doesn’t become more social than through sharing food. That’s our founding food philosophy and it can be yours too. The food that comes out of our Living Kitchen is fresh, simple, honest, healthy and local. With short-end preparation times, simple ingredients and limited preparation steps, our assortment is incredibly intelligent and facilitates fast service.

As our new chef you'll be responsible for any food that comes out of our Living Kitchen. You'll plate beautiful dishes and at times make creative buffets that not only look good, but also taste amazing.

You’ll work closely together with our team of chefs, to develop menu offerings and forecast supply needs. You like to take on responsibility, thrive with independence in your work and function as a substitute for our chefs. 

WHAT MAKES OUR KITCHEN UNIQUE?

  • You won’t hide in the background. You'll get to work in an open kitchen environment with plenty of space and natural daylight.

  • You'll get the ultimate flexibility. You can come up with your own dishes and let your creativity run wild.

  • You can have good conversations with visitors. You’re the face of the kitchen and you'll get to directly chat with guests.

  • You get to be independent in your work. You like doing your own thing and can cook solo when you need to.

  • You can get to know the entire team. You'll be in close contact with our front of house and the entire Zoku team.

  • You can work in a unique kitchen setup. We’re not like your average kitchen (feel free to stop by our rooftop to see for yourself!).

  • You are encouraged to work with fresh and seasonal ingredients. We put a strong emphasis on incorporating vegetables into our dishes.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

  • A market conform salary package including pension and health insurance.

  • Cool benefits like an after-work drink, access to all community events, various discounts like 40% discount on F&B for you and 4 friends, plus Employee and Friends & Family rates in all Zoku Locations.  

  • A free night stay for you and your +1 in your first 3 months at your Zoku (dinner & breakfast) and a free night at any Zoku location for your birthday, including welcome drink & breakfast to experience Zoku as a true guest. 

  • No boring canteen!! Staff meals enjoyed from our Living Kitchen.

  • A personal budget unlocked after 1 year at Zoku to spend on extra days off, learning & development, extra cash or discounted vouchers. 

  • A fun, young, and international team to grow with. Plus, exciting training and events to celebrate every step of the journey!

  • A job at one of the 25 coolest hotels in the world, that feels like a second home and is purpose-driven.

WE LOVE PEOPLE WHO...

  • Show their creativity through their passion for food and never settle for less.

  • Can juggle many tasks at the same time while remaining cool headed and warm hearted.

  • Enjoy variety in their day and are happy to switch things up, whether that means breakfast, brunch, lunch buffets, a la carte dinners or cheffing up something special for our Meetings & Events.

  • Have experience in working independently and don't believe in traditional kitchen hierarchies.

  • Enjoy working in an open kitchen and love to chat up a storm with our residents.

  • Have experience in healthy homestyle cooking – vegetarian cooking skills are a plus.

  • Have provable knowledge of various cooking techniques.

A FEW MUST HAVES

  • You have a minimum of 1 year working experience in a kitchen or restaurant environment. 

  • You have experience with implementing the local HACCP guidelines (Hygiejnebevis).

  • You are fluent in English – Danish and other languages are a plus.

  • You are an EU resident or have a working and living permit valid for Denmark including a CPR.

  • You are fully flexible, as there won't be fixed working days / hours, including availability on some weekends. Shifts include AM, Mid-shifts, and PM.

  • You love to work as we'll need you Full Time (37 hours- 5 shifts weekly)

  • Available to start As Soon As Possible.

WHAT WE ARE PROUD OF 

Our fresh take on hospitality has been recognized around the world with plenty of press attention and design awards.

We’re also proudly B Corp certified at all four of our locations (Amsterdam, Copenhagen, Paris and Vienna), which means we hold ourselves to high standards when it comes to social and environmental impact, transparency and accountability.

WHAT IS ZOKU

title: Service Technician and Installation Supervisor
description: About the positionFerrum is looking for an experienced and hands-on Service Technician and Installation Supervisor who can take responsibility for the installation, start-up and servicing of individual machines and complete filling lines at our customers' sites. We supply solutions for the production and filling of beer and soft drinks, including process equipment, filling machines, conveyors and associated utility systems.You will have a key role at customer sites, combining hands-on work with the coordination of installation, connection, testing and commissioning activities. The position requires solid industry experience and extensive travel. Assignments will mainly be in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe, and you must be prepared for overnight stays, changing working hours and work carried out during production shutdowns.Your main responsibilities•  Plan and carry out the installation, mechanical assembly and run-in of new machines and complete filling lines.•  Act as Installation Supervisor and coordinate Ferrum technicians, customer personnel, subcontractors and other equipment suppliers on site.•  Ensure correct positioning, levelling and mechanical integration of machines, conveyors, piping, platforms and associated equipment.•  Carry out and verify pneumatic connections and assist with the connection of process media and utilities such as compressed air, water, CO2, nitrogen, steam, cooling and CIP.•  Participate in testing, FAT/SAT, commissioning, production start-up and performance runs in close cooperation with project management, automation specialists and the customer.•  Systematically troubleshoot mechanical and pneumatic faults and carry out basic fault-finding on electrical signals, sensors, drives and PLC-related issues.•  Perform service, inspections, preventive maintenance, repairs, modifications and format changeovers on existing systems.•  Identify the root causes of downtime and quality issues and recommend spare parts, maintenance activities and technical improvements.•  Train customer operators and maintenance personnel in safe operation, cleaning, changeovers and routine maintenance.•  Document progress, working hours, deviations, outstanding items and completed work in daily site and service reports.•  Ensure that all work is performed safely and in accordance with applicable safety requirements, customer site rules and relevant hygiene and food-production requirements.•  Provide practical feedback to the project, engineering and service teams to support the continuous improvement of future solutions and installations.Your professional background•  You have a relevant technical qualification, for example as an industrial mechanic, marine engineer, metal fabricator, automation technician or similar. Extensive relevant industry experience may compensate for a different educational background.•  You have several years of hands-on experience with the installation, servicing and commissioning of machinery or complete lines for the beverage, brewery, food or packaging industry.•  You have in-depth knowledge of filling lines and preferably experience with fillers, cappers, can seamers, conveyors, mixers/carbonators, pasteurisation, CIP and utility equipment.•  Experience from a manufacturer or service organisation such as Krones, KHS, Sidel, GEA or another supplier of process and filling lines would be a clear advantage.•  You are able to read and work from mechanical drawings, layouts, P&IDs, pneumatic diagrams, manuals and technical documentation.•  You have strong mechanical expertise and can perform precise alignment, installation, adjustment and systematic troubleshooting.•  Knowledge of electrical systems, instrumentation, variable frequency drives, sensors and Siemens PLC/HMI systems is an advantage, but this is not a dedicated PLC programming role.•  You can communicate professionally in written and spoken English. Danish or another European language would be an advantage.•  You hold a valid driving licence and a valid EU/EEA passport, and are able to travel and work throughout Denmark and Europe without significant restrictions.Personal qualities•  You take ownership of your assignments and maintain an overview, even when schedules are tight or several disciplines are working simultaneously.•  You are hands-on, solution-oriented and comfortable working independently away from the office.•  You communicate clearly and respectfully with customers, colleagues and subcontractors and can lead site meetings in a professional manner.•  You work in a structured manner and follow up on agreements, open items, safety, quality and documentation.•  You are flexible regarding travel, working hours and changing priorities and understand that start-ups and production-critical service assignments may require additional effort.We offer•  A permanent position with significant influence on the successful delivery of international customer projects.•  A varied working day involving new installations, commissioning, service and technical problem-solving.•  The opportunity to work with complete solutions - from process systems and utilities to the finished filling line.•  Close cooperation with project managers, engineers, automation specialists, suppliers and customers' technical organisations.•  An informal company with short decision-making paths, a high level of responsibility and a strong focus on quality and professional integrity.•  Salary and employment terms based on qualifications, together with relevant travel conditions and work equipment.Practical informationWork location: Ferrum's base in Fredericia, combined with assignments at customer sites in Denmark and elsewhere in Europe.Travel: Extensive and varying according to the project portfolio. Overnight travel and assignments lasting several weeks may occur.Employment: Permanent position.ApplicationPlease send your application and CV, including a brief description of your experience with filling lines, installation, service and commissioning. Please also state which machine types and suppliers you have previously worked with and the level of travel you are accustomed to.

title: Er du vores nye højre hånd i den daglige drift?
description:
Aarhus Rengøringsselskab søger en erfaren tilsynsførende, som både har solid erfaring med rengøring og samtidig har lyst til at tage mere ansvar for kvalitet, medarbejdere og den daglige drift.

Stillingen kan være oplagt for dig, der allerede arbejder som rengøringsassistent eller teamleder, og som er klar til at tage det næste skridt i branchen og skabe dig en karriere inden for rengøring.

Du behøver altså ikke nødvendigvis have arbejdet som tilsynsførende tidligere. Det vigtigste er, at du har en stærk faglig baggrund, tager ansvar og har lyst til at udvikle dig i en rolle med mere koordinering, kvalitetssikring og kontakt til både medarbejdere og kunder.

Du bliver en vigtig del af den daglige drift og et tæt bindeled mellem medarbejdere, kunder og ledelsen.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som tilsynsførende vil du blandt andet arbejde med:

  • Tilsyn og kvalitetssikring hos vores kunder

  • Oplæring og introduktion af nye rengøringsassistenter

  • Opfølgning på medarbejdere og arbejdsopgaver

  • Koordinering ved sygdom, ferie og ændringer i driften

  • Kontakt med kunder omkring den daglige rengøring

  • Kontrol af rengøringsstandarder og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Planlægning og udførelse af forskellige specialopgaver

  • Bestilling og levering af materialer og rengøringsmidler

  • Praktisk deltagelse i rengøringsopgaver, når der er behov for det

Du skal derfor være indstillet på, at jobbet både består af tilsyn, koordinering og praktisk rengøringsarbejde.

Vi leder efter dig, der har erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen

Det er vigtigt for os, at du har praktisk erfaring med almindelig professionel rengøring og ved, hvad god kvalitet betyder i praksis.

Vi ser meget gerne, at du også har erfaring med opgaver som:

  • Grundrengøring

  • Hovedrengøring

  • Flytterengøring af lejligheder og erhverv

  • Gulvbehandling

  • Specialrengøring

  • Brug af rengøringsmaskiner og professionelt udstyr

Har du erfaring med polisharbejde, opskuring og behandling af gulve, er det en klar fordel.

Du behøver ikke kunne alt fra første dag, men du skal have en solid faglig forståelse for rengøringsbranchen og lyst til at udvikle dig yderligere.

Måske er du klar til næste skridt?

Du arbejder måske i dag som rengøringsassistent, serviceassistent eller teamleder og kan mærke, at du gerne vil mere.

Måske er du ofte den kollega, andre spørger til råds. Du har styr på kvaliteten, tager ansvar, hjælper nye medarbejdere i gang og har blik for, hvordan opgaverne kan løses bedst muligt.

Hvis du kan genkende dig selv i det, kan stillingen som tilsynsførende hos os være dit næste naturlige skridt.

Vi søger ikke nødvendigvis den kandidat med den flotteste titel på CV'et. Vi søger en person med erfaring, faglig stolthed, ansvarsfølelse og lysten til at udvikle sig og skabe en karriere inden for rengøringsbranchen.

Som person forestiller vi os, at du

  • Har naturligt overblik og tager ansvar

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt

  • Er god til at kommunikere med forskellige mennesker

  • Kan oplære og vejlede medarbejdere på en respektfuld og tydelig måde

  • Har øje for kvalitet og detaljer

  • Er løsningsorienteret og ikke bange for at tage fat

  • Kan bevare roen, når dagens plan pludselig ændrer sig

  • Forstår betydningen af god kundeservice

  • Følger opgaver helt til dørs

Hos os skal en tilsynsførende ikke kun kunne konstatere, at noget ikke er godt nok. Du skal også kunne vise medarbejderen, hvordan opgaven skal løses korrekt.

Praktiske krav

Det er et krav, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen

  • Har kørekort

  • Kan kommunikere på dansk eller tydelig og øvet engelsk

  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret

  • Er fleksibel i forhold til arbejdstider

Det er en fordel, hvis du også kan kommunikere på engelsk, da vi har medarbejdere med forskellige nationaliteter.

Arbejdstid og løn

Arbejdstiden vil som udgangspunkt ligge i dagtimerne.

Da vi arbejder i en branche, hvor opgaver og behov kan opstå uden for almindelig arbejdstid, skal du dog være indstillet på at kunne træde til om aftenen og i weekenderne, når arbejdet kræver det.

Løn aftales individuelt efter kvalifikationer og erfaring.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Du får en stilling med stor variation og mulighed for at få reel indflydelse på den daglige drift.

Vi tilbyder blandt andet:

  • En selvstændig stilling med ansvar

  • En hverdag med både mennesker, kvalitet og praktiske opgaver

  • Tæt samarbejde med virksomhedens ledelse

  • Mulighed for at udvikle dig fagligt og personligt

  • Mulighed for at tage næste skridt i din karriere inden for rengøringsbranchen

  • Stor variation i arbejdsdagen

  • Grundig oplæring i vores kunder, medarbejdere og arbejdsgange

  • Mulighed for at blive en central person i virksomhedens fortsatte udvikling

Om Aarhus Rengøringsselskab

Aarhus Rengøringsselskab er en professionel rengøringsvirksomhed med kunder i Aarhus og omegn.

Vi udfører blandt andet almindelig erhvervsrengøring samt forskellige specialopgaver, og vi lægger stor vægt på høj kvalitet, ordentlighed og gode relationer til både kunder og medarbejdere.

Vi tror på, at den bedste kvalitet opstår, når medarbejderne ved, hvad der forventes, får den nødvendige oplæring og har en leder, der følger op og hjælper dem med at lykkes.

Lyder stillingen som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og dit CV.

Fortæl gerne kort om din erfaring fra rengøringsbranchen, hvilke typer rengøringsopgaver du tidligere har arbejdet med, og hvorfor du gerne vil tage næste skridt i din karriere.

Har du erfaring med eksempelvis grundrengøring, flytterengøring, gulvbehandling eller polisharbejde, må du også meget gerne beskrive det.

Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Aarhus Rengøringsselskab ApS

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric- Copenhagen
description:
Mpya Finance is recruiting a Chief Accountant to Schneider Electric in Copenhagen – a key role for you who want to combine technical accounting expertise with impact, development and an international context.

If you are looking to advance your career, this is your opportunity to take the next step and develop together with Schneider.

At Schneider Electric, sustainability, innovation and performance go hand in hand. This is an opportunity to become a trusted financial partner in an organization that is actively shaping the future of energy.

About the role

As Chief Accountant, you will play a central role in ensuring high-quality financial reporting and compliance across the Nordic and Baltic entities, working closely with the global Shared Service Center in India. You will be part of a strong, international finance organization where collaboration, continuous improvement and professional development are highly valued.

The role offers both responsibility and variety – from statutory reporting and balance sheet ownership to process improvements and cross-border collaboration.

Your main responsibilities:

    

Ensure high quality and accuracy in financial reporting

    

Lead monthly and quarterly closings in accordance with IFRS and local GAAP

    

Full responsibility for balance sheet accuracy and reviews

    

Ownership of annual reports, income tax returns and tax reporting

    

Lead Balance Sheet Review meetings and collaborate with key stakeholders

    

Coordinate and drive external audits for assigned legal entities

    

Drive simplification, standardization and continuous improvement of accounting processes

    

Participate in finance projects, system improvements and ad hoc analyses

Who are we looking for?

To succeed in this role, we believe you have a solid accounting foundation and the confidence to take ownership in a complex, international environment.

We are looking for someone who has:

• A degree in Accounting, Finance or equivalent

• At least 3 years of experience working with Danish accounting, preferably in a global organization

• Experience working with a Shared Service Center (meritorious)

• Strong skills in SAP (or similar), Excel and other MS tools

• Fluency in Danish and English, both written and spoken

As a person, you are structured, methodical, and quality-driven. You take ownership of your responsibilities, work proactively, and thrive in a complex international environment. At the same time, you are a true team player who enjoys collaborating closely with colleagues and stakeholders across functions and geographies.

We believe that success in this role comes from balancing strong individual accountability with a collaborative mindset. You build trust easily, communicate clearly, and actively contribute to the team's results and development. You enjoy sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues, and working together to achieve common goals.

What Schneider Electric offers

At Schneider Electric, you will join a globally recognized company with a strong commitment to sustainability, innovation and people development. You will be part of a professional and forward-looking finance organization where you are encouraged to grow, challenge existing ways of working and develop your career over time.

This is a role where your expertise truly matters – and where you can make a real impact.

Learn more at www.se.com

Application

In this recruitment, Schneider Electric cooperates with Mpya Finance. Selection is ongoing, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

For questions about the role or the process, please contact: Kristina Bennet – kristina.bennet@mpya.se Johanna Andersson – johanna.andersson@mpya.se

Welcome with your application – we look forward to hearing from you.

title: Er du Stege Kirkes nye organist?
description:
Stege Kirke på Møn søger en dygtig og engageret organist til ansættelse pr. 1. december 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Stillingen er på 35 timer ugentligt.

Stege Kirke er en levende kirke, som ønsker at komme sognet i møde, men samtidig respekterer kirkens dybe tradition. Vi har fokus på et sundt og konstruktivt arbejdsmiljø og tilbyder et selvstændigt arbejde med god mulighed for at planlægge din egen tid.

Organisten skal varetage følgende opgaver:
  • Spille orgel og klaver ved højmesser og alle typer kirkelige handlinger i vor sognekirke og kirkegårdskapel, samt når vi holder gudstjenester på vores plejehjem.
  • Opbygning og udvikling af vores pigekor - 13-22 år - og eventuelt et spirekor samt kirkens voksenkor. Pigekoret deltager ved gudstjenester i stedet for kirkesanger, og voksenkoret deltager ved cirka en månedlig gudstjeneste i vinterhalvåret. Er der færre end tre piger til en gudstjeneste, medvirker en kirkesanger.
  • Spille til en månedlig sangcafé.
  • At afholde musik- og korarrangementer og fællessang i kirken for menigheden.
  • Lejlighedsvis deltage ved undervisning af konfirmander og minikonfirmander, børnegudstjenester, julearrangementer m.m.
  • Deltage i planlægningsmøder og samarbejde med kirkens øvrige ansatte og præster om kirkens musikliv og koncerter.
  • Ved kirkelige handlinger bisættelser, begravelser, vielser og lørdagsdåb bruger vi kirkesanger.

Alle arrangementer i kirken og sognegården koordineres i samarbejde med aktivitetsudvalget, som organisten er medlem af.

Stege Sogn har ca. 4000 indbyggere, og vi har en kordegn, en kirketjener og to præster samt et hold medarbejdere på kirkegården.

Stege Kirke stammer tilbage fra 1200-tallet og er blevet til i nuværende skikkelse ad flere omgange. Først i gotisk tid, 1460-1525, blev kirken udvidet til den størrelse, den har i dag.

Kirken har en dejlig sognegård med plads til aktiviteter i løbet af ugen.

Se kirkens hjemmeside: www.stegekirke.dk

Kirken har to orgler. Pinsedag 1966 blev vort såkaldt Andersenorgel indviet. Det er tegnet og bygget af Poul Gerhard Andersen i samarbejde med arkitekt Rolf Graae.

Orglet har 25 stemmer fordelt på hovedværk, brystværk, positiv, som vender op mod alteret, og pedal. Denne noget utraditionelle placering af orglet midt i kirken har både historiske og akustiske årsager.

Kirken har tillige et historisk orgel placeret på pulpituret i vestenden af kirken. Det er bygget i 1897 af A.H. Busch & sønner. Det har 14 stemmer og stod oprindelige i Bethesda Kirkesal i København, men blev i 2021 flyttet til Stege og gennemgribende restaureret af Th. Frobenius og sønner.

Der er desuden et Hindsberg flygel i kirken, et klaver samt lydanlæg. Kirken har også et mindre nyindkøbt el-klaver til brug ved et par årlige udendørs gudstjenester i Middelalderhaven, der er beliggende i forlængelse af kirkepladsen.

I kirkegårdskapellet har vi et mindre Busch-orgel, der netop er under restaurering.

Vi holder højmesse i Stege Kirke hver søndag, og der er en god kirkegang med en kernemenighed samt en del sommerhusgæster, og vi gør meget for at have et åbent og godt sogneliv.

Vi bruger ofte udover salmebogen 100 salmer, højskolesangbogen samt kirkesangbogen.

Vi forventer, at du:
  • Har gode dokumenterede faglige kvalifikationer og favner musisk bredt og har interesse i at facilitere musik og sang.
  • Har gode samarbejdsevner
  • Har lyst til at engagere dig i kirkens liv og vækst
  • Er fleksibel
  • Har evnen til at arbejde selvstændigt

Vil du vide mere om løn- og ansættelsesvilkår?
Hvis vi har fanget din interesse og vil vide mere om stillingens formelle betingelser, kan du læse mere her (https://www.jobindex.dk/img/pdf/Lon_Ansaettelse_Stege.pdf).

Nærmere oplysning om stillingen fås ved henvendelse til personaleansvarlige Birgit Buddegård på telefonnummer 2095 6513 eller menighedsrådsformand Anne-Lise Nielsen på telefonnummer 2570 2414.

title: AI Manager (m/w/d) (KI-Manager/in)
description:
Willst du KI in echten geschäftlichen Mehrwert für die DLG verwandeln? Als **AI Manager (m/w/d)** spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Group IT. Du bist dafür verantwortlich, die KI‑Strategie der DLG weiterzuentwickeln und umzusetzen – in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den verschiedenen Geschäftsbereichen. In dieser Rolle treibst du nicht nur die Richtung und Umsetzung von KI‑Initiativen voran, sondern baust auch ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf und führst es. Du schaffst die Grundlage dafür, wie wir KI‑Lösungen entwickeln, skalieren und im gesamten Unternehmen betreiben.

Über das Unternehmen

Die DLG-Gruppe zählt zu den führenden Genossenschaften Europas in den Bereichen Lebensmittel, Energie und Baustoffe. Unser Auftrag ist es, langfristigen Mehrwert für unsere landwirtschaftlichen Eigentümer und für die Gesellschaft zu schaffen – durch verlässliche Produkte, innovative Lösungen und nachhaltiges Wachstum in all unseren Geschäftsbereichen. Mit rund 7.000 Mitarbeitenden in 18 Ländern und auf Basis unserer genossenschaftlichen Struktur gestalten wir unsere Zukunft durch gemeinsame Werte, nachhaltige Ziele und den festen Glauben an die Kraft der Zusammenarbeit.

Die team SE mit Sitz in Flensburg ist ein wesentlicher Bestandteil der DLG-Gruppe. Unsere zentralen Unternehmensfunktionen sind standortübergreifend zwischen Flensburg und dem DLG-Hauptsitz in Fredericia organisiert. Gemeinsam unterstützen wir die Geschäftsbereiche über Ländergrenzen hinweg und tragen zu einer effizienten, integrierten und zukunftsfähigen Organisation bei, die Skaleneffekte und Synergien optimal nutzt.

Aufgaben

Du prägst die KI‑Ausrichtung der DLG und leitest ein Team, das wirkungsvolle, geschäftsorientierte Lösungen liefert. Konkret bedeutet das:

- Du definierst und verantwortest die KI‑Roadmap sowie das Use‑Case‑Portfolio über alle Geschäftsbereiche hinweg.
- Du baust ein Team von KI‑Spezialist*innen auf, führst und entwickelst es weiter.
- Du übersetzt fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare und wirkungsvolle KI‑Lösungen.
- Du steuerst das Solution Design – von der Idee über Architekturentscheidungen bis zur Implementierung.
- Du etablierst Standards für Daten, Integrationen, Sicherheit, Skalierbarkeit und Responsible AI.
- Du arbeitest eng mit technischen Teams, externen Partnern und Dienstleistern zusammen, um Fortschritt und Qualität sicherzustellen.
- Du unterstützt Build-or-Buy‑Entscheidungen und sorgst für die Abstimmung mit den Enterprise‑Plattformen.

Profil

Du bist eine erfahrene **Führungskraft (m/w/d)** mit einer starken technischen Basis und einer Leidenschaft dafür, sowohl Menschen als auch Lösungen weiterzuentwickeln. Du arbeitest strukturiert und pragmatisch und erzielst Ergebnisse sowohl durch dein Team als auch durch deine eigene Expertise. Du bewegst dich sicher zwischen Business und IT und weißt, wie man Richtung, Alignment und Momentum in einem komplexen Stakeholder‑Umfeld schafft.

Um in dieser Rolle erfolgreich zu sein, solltest du:

- nachweisliche Erfahrung in der Führung und Entwicklung von Teams im Bereich KI, Daten oder Advanced Analytics mitbringen
- ein tiefes Verständnis für Solution Architecture und komplexe IT‑Landschaften haben
- Erfahrung darin haben, KI‑ oder Dateninitiativen von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung zu treiben
- in der Lage sein, geschäftliche Prioritäten mit technologischen Möglichkeiten zu verbinden
- Erfahrung mit Governance, Priorisierung und funktionsübergreifenden Entscheidungen haben
- eine starke Führungspersönlichkeit sein, die motiviert, coacht und Engagement schafft
- strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert arbeiten
- klar kommunizieren und komplexe Themen verständlich machen
- sicher in Deutsch und Englisch kommunizieren

Unser Angebot

Bei DLG erwartet dich eine spannende und wirkungsvolle Rolle in einem Unternehmen, in dem KI und Digitalisierung ganz oben auf der Agenda stehen.

Du kannst dich freuen auf:

- eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Gestaltung der KI‑Ausrichtung eines internationalen Unternehmens
- die Möglichkeit, eine neue KI‑Funktion innerhalb der DLG aufzubauen und zu führen
- ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung und Einfluss
- ein starkes professionelles Umfeld in IT, Daten und Digitalisierung
- persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten
- flexible Arbeitsbedingungen und eine gesunde Work‑Life‑Balance

Kontakt

title: Declaration of interest regarding PhD project at The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU)
description:
The National Institute of Public Health at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applicants for a 3-year PhD scholarship for a highly motivated candidate interested in working within the field of environmental epidemiology and public health. The project aims to investigate new and previously suspected toxicants to risk of Parkinsons Disease.

The PhD project is part of a larger collaborative research initiative “Connecting the environmental exposome to PD risk and disease pathology” funded by Michael J Fox Foundation. Through this grant, a 3-year PhD position has been funded. The larger project includes four work packages (WPs), where the PhD project is part of the WP with the title “Toxicant-wide association studies for PD”, which also includes funding for two part time researchers.


Research environment

The PhD project will be anchored at the National Institute of Public Health within the research group in Geographical and Register-based Epidemiology in Copenhagen. Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll will be the principal supervisor, researcher Stine Kloster and researcher Kirstine Wodschow will be co-supervisors. The project will be conducted in close collaboration with the research team in the larger project. Together, the larger team provides an interdisciplinary research environment with close integration of public health, in vivo and in vitro experimental research, neurology, register-based research and environmental epidemiology. The teams are internationally oriented and offer a supportive and inclusive research culture.

You can read more about the research initiative here:  https://www.michaeljfox.org/grant/connecting-environmental-exposome-pd-risk-and-disease-pathology. 

 

Project description

The PhD project will focus on associations between toxicants and risk for Parkinsons Disease. The association between toxicant exposure at residential location and incidence of Parkinsons Disease will be investigated for the entire Danish adult population through access to Danish national registers. Toxicants will include pesticides in drinking water, airborne pesticides exposure from fields and larger chemical pollutions.

Together with the researchers in WP4 the PhD student will:

  • Establish the study population of the entire Danish adults 

  • Derive toxicant exposure at an individual level

  • Analyze associations between toxicant exposure and risk of Parkinsons Disease

  • Prepare and publish research findings in international peer-reviewed journals.

 

Qualifications

The applicant should possess the following qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have demonstrated an interest in research within epidemiology, environmental medicine, or data science

  • A master’s degree (MSc or equivalent) in public health, epidemiology, data science or related fields

  • Experience with programming using statistical software (such as SAS, Stata or R) is considered a strength but not a requirement

  • Preferably prior experience with register-based and/or environmental epidemiology

  • An interest in working with quantitative analyses and large datasets

  • Excellent communications skills in English, both written and spoken

  • A motivated, independent, and quality-oriented approach to research, with enthusiasm for learning new scientific disciplines and methodologies.

 

For further information about the project, please contact:
Professor Annette Kjær Ersbøll

The National Institute of Public Health 

University of Southern Denmark (SDU)

Phone: +45 65507775   E-mail: ake@sdu.dk


Applications must include:

• At letter stating the interest, motivation and qualifications for the project (max. 2 pages) - upload under “Application form”.
• Detailed CV, including personal contact information
• Certified copy of diploma (Master’s degree in a relevant field)

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process.

Further information about the PhD-study can be found at the homepage of the University.


Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now". Attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Incomplete applications and applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated. This also applies to reference letters.

 

Closing date October 9th, 2026


Successful candidates will be asked to send an application to the PhD Secretariat, Faculty of Health Sciences, to be enrolled as PhD students.

The PhD programme will be carried out in accordance with Faculty regulations and the Danish Ministerial Order on the PhD Programme at the Universities (PhD order).

 

Salary and Working Conditions at SDU

PhD students employed at SDU are employed as PhD fellows according to the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations in public employment (AC) agreement.


Salary and any salary supplement are paid according to your seniority level and as negotiated with your union representative. The base salary (excluding 18.07% pension contribution) is DKK 374,912.98.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Postdoc Position in Materials Chemistry at the Mads Clausen Institute, The University of Southern Denmark in Sønderborg, Denmark
description:
We are seeking an enthusiastic new colleague as a postdoctoral research associate in the field of Materials Chemistry with a strong background, particularly in Solid State Chemistry and (Photo)electrochemistry, and interest in industrial applications and cooperation to join the Mads Clausen Institute (MCI) at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) in Sønderborg, Denmark. The position is for two years with an expected starting date of 01.03.2027. 

MCI is a part of the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) and covers research and education, including applications of engineering sciences. Our working language is English, reflecting the fact that far more than half of our students and staff have international roots. We are located at SDU’s beautiful campus in Sønderborg, in the inspiring building of Alsion, which is a centre for science, culture and learning in the heart of Sønderborg and perched on the strait of water separating the island of Als from the mainland. The university has very close relations with industries in Sønderborg, Southern Denmark, and Northern Germany.

The successful candidate is expected to carry out research mainly within a project funded by the Novo Nordisk Foundation. The project is hosted by the nanotechnology centre NanoSYD, a part of MCI, and it is integrated into the novel, active working group CatMatX, a research laboratory focused on developing next-generation catalytic materials for sustainable energy and environmental applications,  by Professor Mirabbos Hojamberdiev. The research work involves the synthesis and characterization of novel compounds based on mixed-anion compounds (e.g., transition metal (oxy)nitrides) and the evaluation of their performance in solar water splitting. Also, the successful candidate is expected to be actively involved in the supervision of MSc and PhD students affiliated with SDU NanoSYD, preparing project reports, presentations, and publications, as well as writing project proposals to support research at SDU NanoSYD. 

Job Description and Responsibilities

  • Implementation of research tasks related to the project;

  • Collaborative and independent research planning, materials synthesis and characterization, and evaluation of materials performance in solar water splitting;

  • Independent characterization, data analysis, and interpretation of research results;

  • Scientific communication and presentation of research results at group seminars, scientific conferences, project meetings, etc.;

  • Publishing of project results in international peer-reviewed scientific journals with high impact factors.

Potential Responsibilities 

  • Supervision of BSc, MSc, and exchange/visiting students who perform research work on similar research topics; 

  • Assistance in teaching activities; 

  • Assistance in setting up the research infrastructure;

  • Assistance in the preparation of grant proposals for external funding. 

Mandatory qualifications 

  • PhD degree in Materials Science, Materials Chemistry, Solid State Chemistry, Solid State Physics, Electrochemistry, or related fields; 

  • Proven hands-on experience and knowledge of various synthesis methods in solid-state chemistry, preferably the methods used for the synthesis of mixed-anion compounds;

  • Technical skills in materials characterization techniques (e.g., XRD, XPS, SEM);   

  • Proven track record of publishing in international peer-reviewed scientific journals as leading author;

  • Fluency in English (both spoken and written);

  • Ability to work in teams and also independently; 

  • Strong communication skills; 

  • Willingness to collaborate with other scientists and industry. 

The following qualifications are advantageous

  • Research experience in X-ray, synchrotron, and neutron radiation facilities, DFT calculations and MD simulations;

  • Research experience in electrochemistry and solar water splitting; 

  • Technical skills in scientific illustration and animation to deliver visual knowledge of the project; 

  • Proven record in participating in national and international research projects;

  • Strong interest in a long-term commitment to a growing research group.

Contact information

For more information about the department and the position, please contact Mirabbos Hojamberdiev (mirabbos@mci.sdu.dk) and Horst-Günter Rubahn (rubahn@mci.sdu.dk)

If you experience technical problems, please contact hcm-support@sdu.dk. 

Conditions of employment

Appointment as a postdoctoral researcher is temporary and for an initial 2-year period, and it starts on 01.03.2027. Extension may be possible depending on available funding. (no more than 4 years at the same university)

Appointment to the position will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state with the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described herein. Please check links for more information on salary (only available in Danish) and taxation.

The person employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a self-organiser.

The assessment and evaluation process

The application

The application and all appendices must be in English. We request files in pdf-format no more than 5 MB per file. All pdf-files must be unlocked and allow binding and may not be password protected. Documents should not contain a CPR number (civil registration number) – in this case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

UPLOAD GUIDE: Motivated application shall be uploaded as ‘Cover letter’, Curriculum Vitae shall be uploaded as ‘Resume’. All other documents shall be uploaded as ‘Miscellaneous documents’.

If the application does not meet the requirements mentioned above, the faculty may reject your application without further notice. Applications received after the deadline will neither be considered nor evaluated.
