title: Senior Solution Architect IT/OT Security Platforms (f/m/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
description:
Siemens IT enables secure, reliable and scalable digital services for Siemens businesses and factories worldwide. Within IT IPS, we develop and operate services that support the transformation of industrial environments towards modern, secure and standardized IT/OT operations.
As a Solution Architect for our IT/OT Security Platforms you will define the technical vision and architecture for strategic service offerings. You will work closely with factories, cybersecurity experts, service managers, product teams, and technology partners to design scalable, secure, and future-ready solutions that support Siemens' Zero Trust and digitalization strategy. Our OT Zero Trust Platform enables secure IT/OT communication through identity-based connectivity concepts, while our OT Patch Management enables centralized endpoint management, patching, hardening and compliance for enterprise and production-related devices.

What we offer you
At Siemens, our Total Rewards approach is designed to inspire innovation, reward impact, and support your well-being at every stage of your career.  From competitive pay and benefits to recognition and development opportunities, we help you thrive both personally and professionally.

You'll make an impact by

- You design and evolve the target architecture for our IT/OT Security Platforms (SINEC Secure Connect and ManageEngine), ensuring alignment with Siemens cybersecurity, operational, and business requirements.- You define secure IT/OT communication concepts based on Zero Trust principles and develop architectures for remote access, machine connectivity, application communication, and future AI-driven use cases.- You support Siemens factories in integrating modern security and management solutions into existing brownfield environments, considering legacy systems, industrial protocols, and operational constraints.- You translate business, security, and operational requirements into scalable platform architectures, governance models, technical standards, and implementation roadmaps.- You collaborate with factories, cybersecurity teams, service owners, vendors, and technology partners to establish architecture standards and drive service adoption across Siemens.- You define integration concepts between connectivity services, endpoint management platforms, monitoring solutions, automation frameworks, and enterprise systems.- You evaluate new technologies and architecture patterns and contribute to the continuous evolution of Siemens' IT/OT security and platform landscape.- You enable data-driven and AI-supported operational use cases by designing architectures that support secure data flows, automation, analytics, and platform interoperability.- You actively shape the journey to AI-native OT security services

This is how you'll win us over

- Education: You have a university degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a comparable qualification.- Experience and Skills:- You possess strong expertise in Zero Trust and OT Security Architecture, including concepts such as identity-centric networking, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, and industry frameworks such as NIST SP 800-207 and IEC 62443.- You have proven experience with OT Infrastructure and Brownfield Integration (of at least 3+ years), including industrial environments, legacy systems, machine-to-machine communication, industrial protocols, network segmentation, and hybrid IT/OT architectures.- You bring solid knowledge of Endpoint, Asset and Service Management Architectures, including endpoint management, asset discovery, software deployment, patch management, CMDB, and IT service management platforms.- You are experienced in Platform and Enterprise Architecture (of at least 3+ years) and can translate business and security requirements into scalable technical solutions, governance models, operating concepts, and technology roadmaps.- You possess strong capabilities in Platform Integration, Automation, AI and Analytics, including API-based integration, monitoring, automation, operational data flows, and AI-ready platform design.
- Ways of Working: - You are able to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders and successfully align diverse stakeholder groups.- You work in a structured and strategic manner and are comfortable operating in international and cross-functional environments.- You provide your support during Central European Time Zone (CET).
- Languages: •    Fluent English skills complete your profile. German language skills are beneficial.

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.
As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/de/de/unternehmen/jobs/arbeiten-bei-siemens/inklusion.html) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities.

To solve the biggest challenges of our time, we need bright minds with the ambition to make the impossible possible. Siemens is the place where you can thrive, challenge the status quo, make an impact, and grow alongside a team of innovators who share your passion for technology. Are you in?

Die Einrichtung liegt sehr zentral direkt an der Ludwig-Thoma-Wiese in einer charmanten "alten Villa" in Dachau umgeben von einem wunderschönen Garten. Uns erreicht man nach einer kurzen Busfahrt vom Dachauer Bahnhof mit der Buslinie 719. In den drei Gruppen finden bis zu 78 Kinder Platz.
Wir legen großen Wert darauf, dass die Kita für unsere Kinder ein Schutz- und Lernort ist, was wir durch ein umfassendes Gewaltschutzkonzept mit präventiven und intervenierenden Maßnahmen im pädagogischen Alltag umsetzen.

description:
We shape trust in the digital age!
At G+D, we are creating confidence, with built-in security tech in three segments: Digital Security, Financial Platforms and Currency Technology. To our customers, we have been a reliable partner for more than 170 years. With our offering, we are well positioned to support them on their future journey. Discover our innovative SecurityTech solutions!
With our cash management and cash logistics solutions, G+D is driving the digital transformation of the global cash cycle. As a leading provider in this market, we support central banks, commercial banks, and cash-in-transit companies worldwide with innovative, secure, and highly reliable solutions.
As a Java Developer (m/f/d), you will play a key role in designing, developing, and enhancing our mission-critical cash management and logistics platforms. You will contribute to the development of secure, scalable, and high-performance enterprise applications based on Java technologies, with a strong focus on the Spring ecosystem and modern software engineering practices.
In addition, you will help shape the future of software development at G+D by leveraging AI-assisted development tools and approaches. Working closely with your team, you will explore how coding assistants and AI agents can be used effectively, responsibly, and securely to improve productivity, software quality, testing, and documentation.
This role is based in Munich and offers the opportunity to work in a highly international environment. You will collaborate daily with an agile Scrum team primarily located in Gurugram, India, making strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset essential. If you enjoy working across cultures and contributing to globally distributed teams, we look forward to meeting you.

Your Responsibilities

- Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based enterprise applications with a strong focus on security, performance, scalability, and maintainability
- Contribute to technical design decisions, effort estimations, and architectural discussions
- Develop proof-of-concepts to evaluate and validate technical solutions and new technologies
- Collaborate closely with business analysts, testers, support specialists, and fellow developers throughout the software development lifecycle
- Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve technical issues and production incidents
- Apply and promote AI-assisted software development practices, ensuring responsible usage and validation of AI-generated results
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of our cross-functional agile team, fostering engineering excellence, built-in quality, test-driven development, security-by-design, and AI-first approaches
- Support knowledge sharing and actively contribute to a culture of continuous learning and innovation

Your Qualifications

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
- 5+ years of professional experience in Java software development
- Strong expertise in Java, Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA, EJB, and RESTful APIs
- Experience with enterprise application servers such as WebSphere or JBoss
- Solid understanding of object-oriented design principles, software architecture, and enterprise application development
- Hands-on experience with non-functional requirements, including security, performance optimization, scalability, and automated testing
- Experience with relational databases such as Oracle or Microsoft SQL Server, including query optimization and performance tuning
- Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and a strong understanding of responsible AI usage, security considerations, and result validation
- Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and debugging skills
- Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively in an international environment

Bei Qualitätsabweichungen nutzen Sie definierte Eskalationswege direkt in das Projekt-Steering.

Sie koordinieren das operative Testmanagement, steuern die Datenmigrations- und Conversion-Tests, planen Berechtigungs- und Rollentests ein und begleiten die kritischen Phasen des Cutovers sowie nachgelagerte Releases.
- End-to-End Prozessfokus: Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen entwickeln Sie komplexe Testfälle für zentrale Prozessketten wie bspw. Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P) sowie Logistik- und Finance-Abläufe, inklusive der Schnittstellen zu unseren Non-SAP-Systemen.
- Automatisierung & Strategie: Sie agieren als strategischer Kopf der Testautomatisierung. Sie identifizieren Use-Cases, etablieren Standards und koordinieren die Umsetzung durch interne oder externe Spezialisten.
- Kontinuierliche Optimierung: Sie treiben die Weiterentwicklung unserer Testumgebungen und des Testdatenmanagements voran, um Effizienz und Wartbarkeit nachhaltig zu steigern

DAS BRINGEN SIE MIT:

- Expertise: Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Testmanagement komplexer IT-Projekte. Sie verstehen die Abhängigkeiten in integrierten Systemlandschaften und haben bereits aktiv (globale) Transformationen im SAP S/4 HANA ERP Umfeld begleitet.
- Erfahrung mit der Einführung und Nutzung von Testautomatisierungstools im SAP S/4 HANA ERP Umfeld
- Methoden & Tools: Sie sind sicher in klassischen (V-Modell), agilen (Scrum, Kanban) sowie hybriden Vorgehensmodellen (z. B. SAP Activate und SAFe). Der Umgang mit gängigen Testmanagement-Tools (z. B. Jira Xray und SAP Cloud ALM) ist Ihnen bestens vertraut.

- Sprachen: Sicheres Deutsch (C1) und Englisch (B2) für die tägliche Kommunikation im internationalen Umfeld.
- Ihre Persönlichkeit: Als kommunikationsstarker Stakeholder-Manager moderieren Sie souverän zwischen Fachbereich, IT und externen Providern. Sie treffen auch unter Zeitdruck fundierte Entscheidungen und bewahren in Konfliktsituationen stets den Fokus auf die Lösung.

title: Expert Commissioning (m/f/d) (Inbetriebnahmeingenieur/in)
description:
Your vision is ambitious. Just like ours.
Our people are our success. As one of us, you will contribute to engineering excellence for the high-tech markets of the future, including semiconductors, batteries, pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, and data centers. Discover your exciting role

As an Expert Commissioning, you will be part of our Quality & Commissioning team, applying your electrical expertise to ensure systems are properly installed, tested, and commissioned, while supporting the smooth and coordinated execution of all commissioning activities.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Manage end-to-end commissioning activities for assigned electrical systems and packages, ensuring structured progression from construction completion through testing, energization, and final turnover

description:
Wir sind...

… die Caritas Kooperative Ganztagesbildung an der Ruth Drexel Schule, nur einen Katzensprung von der Tram-Station Prinz-Eugen-Park (Tram 16/37) entfernt, ein Ort, an dem Willkommenskultur und Wohlfühlatmosphäre und deren Wichtigkeit im Mittelpunkt stehen. Mit einem großzügigen Freigelände inklusive Kletterwand, Spielinseln, und Fußballplatz sowie einer Turnhalle und verschiedenen Sport-AGs bieten wir den perfekten Ausgleich zum langen Stillsitzen. description:
Als anerkannter Träger versteht sich die Kindervereinigung Dresden e.V. als Interessenvertreter der jüngsten Mitglieder der Gesellschaft.

Unser gemeinnütziger Auftrag ist es, die bestmögliche Entwicklung von Kindern und Jugendlichen zu selbstbestimmten und starken Persönlichkeiten zu unterstützen sowie deren Familien dahingehend zu fördern.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir ab dem 15.12.2026 im Rahmen von 32 Stunden pro Woche einen engagierten

Pädagogischen Mitarbeiter (m/w/d)

für unsere sozialpädagogisch betreute Wohngruppe in Dresden Blasewitz          

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehören u.a.:

- Grundsätzliche Ausrichtung der pädagogischen Arbeit an den Werten und Rechten von Kindern und Jugendlichen,
- Betreuung von Kindern und Jugendlichen in sozialpädagogisch betreuter Wohngruppe,
- Interesse an den Themen, Träumen, Zielen, Sorgen und Ideen der Mitbewohner*innen,
- gemeinsame Ausgestaltung der Tages- und Wochenabläufe sowie von Gruppenstunden, Freizeiten, Festen und Ferienzeiten,
- Zusammenarbeit mit dem Jugendamt, Kooperationspartnern und Hilfesystemen,
- aktive Mitarbeit bei der inhaltlichen und konzeptionellen Weiterentwicklung der Wohngruppe,
- Arbeit im Schichtsystem, auch an Sonn- und Feiertagen.

Ihr Profil:

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als staatlich anerkannter Sozialpädagoge (m/w/d),
- Freude an der Arbeit sowie Erfahrung und Verständnis im Umgang mit Kindern und Jugendlichen in besonderen Lebenslagen,
- souveränes Auftreten bei Herausforderungen und Konflikten,
- Berufserfahrungen im Arbeitsfeld der Hilfen zur Erziehung.

Wir bieten:

- Einbindung in ein wertschätzendes und sich unterstützendes Team,
- Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten,
- regelmäßige Supervision,
- Vergütung in Anlehnung an den TVöD SuE inkl. Zulagen,
- Möglichkeit der betrieblichen Altersvorsorge sowie vermögenswirksamer Leistungen.

Integrationsassistenz (m/w/d) im Friedrich-Fröbel-Kindergarten in Breisach-Gündlingen

mit einem Stellumfang von 60% (25h).

Werde Wegbegleiter:in für einen kleine Entdecker!

Du möchtest eine Aufgabe, bei der du nicht nur dabei bist, sondern wirklich etwas bewirken kannst? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

Im Friedrich-Fröbel-Kindergarten in Breisach-Gündlingen suchen wir eine engagierte und einfühlsame Person, die ein besonderes Kind im Kindergartenalltag begleitet.

Deine Aufgabe mit Herz und Wirkung

Als Integrationsassistenz wirst du zu einer wichtigen Bezugsperson. Du gibst Orientierung und Sicherheit, begleitest den jungen Menschen durch den Kindergartenalltag und unterstützt ihn dabei, neue Situationen zu meistern und Schritt für Schritt selbstständiger zu werden.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, alles abzunehmen – sondern darum, zur richtigen Zeit da zu sein, Sicherheit zu geben und Entwicklung zu ermöglichen.

Du begleitest ihn bei Aktivitäten, unterstützt ihn im Umgang mit Reizen und hilfst ihm dabei, seine Bedürfnisse wahrzunehmen und seinen eigenen Weg im Kindergarten zu finden.

Das erwartet dich

- Begleitung und Unterstützung im täglichen Kindergartenalltag
- Orientierung und Hilfestellung in unterschiedlichen Situationen
- Unterstützung bei körperlichen Einschränkungen und besonderen Bedürfnissen
- Begleitung bei Aktivitäten, Angeboten und im sozialen Miteinander
- Unterstützung bei der selbstständigen Teilnahme am Kindergartenalltag
- Förderung von Teilhabe und Inklusion
- enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem pädagogischen Team und den beteiligten Fachkräften

Das bringst du mit

Du musst nicht alles können – aber du solltest Freude daran haben, dich auf ein Kind einzulassen.

Wir freuen uns über Menschen, die:

- empathisch, geduldig und aufmerksam sind
- Freude an der Arbeit mit Kindern haben
- zuverlässig und verantwortungsbewusst arbeiten
- offen für die besonderen Bedürfnisse eines Kindes sind
- gerne im Team arbeiten und sich mit anderen austauschen
- selbstständig arbeiten können
- bereit sind, Neues zu lernen und sich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln

Erfahrungen im sozialen, pädagogischen oder pflegerischen Bereich sind willkommen, beispielsweise durch Praktika, Ehrenamt oder bisherige berufliche Tätigkeiten – aber keine Voraussetzung.

Was wir dir bieten

- eine sinnstiftende und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit, bei der du wirklich etwas bewirken kannst
- ein unbefristetes Arbeitsverhältnis
- eine attraktive Vergütung
- eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Benefits wie Hansefit und Deutsches Dienstrad
- eine fundierte fachliche Einarbeitung
- regelmäßige Teambesprechungen und kollegialen Austausch
- bedarfsgerechte Beratung und Supervision
- Unterstützung bei deinen persönlichen Fortbildungswünschen
- interne Schulungen zu pädagogischen und fachbezogenen Themen
- einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz bei einem etablierten und gut vernetzten Träger
- ein wertschätzendes und kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld

Eine Aufgabe, die etwas bewegt

Manchmal sind es die kleinen Dinge, die einen großen Unterschied machen: Geduld, ein ruhiger Moment, ein ermutigendes Wort oder einfach jemand, der Sicherheit gibt.

Als Integrationsassistenz kannst du ein Kind ein Stück auf seinem Weg begleiten, ihm neue Möglichkeiten eröffnen und seine Teilhabe am Kindergartenalltag stärken.

Wenn du dir vorstellen kannst, mit Herz, Geduld und Einfühlungsvermögen etwas zu bewegen, freuen wir uns auf dich!

title: Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
description:
Swedish Speaking Automotive Warranty Assistant (Opel/Vauxhall)
Location: Budaörs, Budapest, Hungary

Concentrix, a global leader in Customer Service, work in partnership with the prestigious Opel/Vauxhall brand across Europe. We are currently recruiting for Warranty Assistants to join our team in Budaörs, Hungary. Located in state of the art facilities, our team of multilingual experts support a range of languages and assist the Opel/Vauxhall dealer network with the diagnosis and repair of vehicles.

What you can expect day to day:
. Handle warranty claims via phone and email.
. Fully investigating the request using Opel/Vauxhall systems, protocol and procedures.
. Escalating requests that cannot be resolved to other team members, and team leaders located both in the UK and Germany.
. Delivering service excellence by efficiently problem-solving and reacting in a professional, polite and clear manner.

What we're looking for:
. Automotive knowledge and experience preferred, gained either in a dealership, preferably Opel/Vauxhall, or with an OEM or OEM supplier business.
. Fluency in English & Swedish.
. Previous experience of handling warranty claims preferred.
. Excellent interpersonal skills, able to build constructive & effective relationships, using appropriate rapport,     diplomacy and tact.
. Ability to resolve queries to a high level remotely by telephone/email.
. Opel/Vauxhall product experience preferable.
. Good computer literacy - competent in the main Microsoft Office packages.
. Able to write clearly and succinctly in a variety of communication settings and styles.
. Time management skills, able to use time effectively and efficiently.
. Customer focus, dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of internal & external customers.

What can we offer you?
. Bright, modern, exciting place to work with excellent staff facilities
. Multicultural, multilingual environment.
. Excellent relocation package.
. Annual Reward & Recognition Ceremony.
. Professional development opportunities.

Relocating to Budaörs?

If you are relocating we'll help with travel costs, accommodation on arrival and salary advances to help get you settled.

Budaörs is a small city of around 30,000 people, situated at the southern edge of the Buda Hills less than 10km from Budapest. The city offers contemporary architecture, the picturesque old town, breath-taking natural surroundings and historic monuments. You can reach Budapest in a matter of minutes via road or public transport.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Prentari / Printer
description:
Prentmet Oddi leitar að ábyrgðarmiklum, nákvæmum og metnaðarfullum starfsmanni til að sinna starfi prentara.
Um er að ræða fjölbreytt og krefjandi starf í öflugu framleiðsluumhverfi þar sem gæði, þjónusta og fagmennska eru í fyrirrúmi.

Helstu verkefni:
Stýra og hafa umsjón með offsetprentvél.
Úttekt og samanburður prófarka og prentarka til að tryggja gæði framleiðslu.
Umsjón með viðhaldi véla og útfylling viðhaldsbókar.
Veita svör og ráðgjöf varðandi prentun og tæknileg atriði.
Umhirða og frágangur vinnuaðstöðu.
Önnur tilfallandi verkefni tengd starfssviðinu.

Hæfniskröfur:
Reynsla af offsetprentun eða sambærilegri framleiðslu er kostur.
Góð tæknileg þekking og hæfni til að vinna sjálfstætt.
Nákvæmni, skipulagshæfni og öguð vinnubrögð.
Jákvætt viðhorf og góð samstarfshæfni.
Áhugi á gæðum og stöðugum umbótum.

Launakjör fara eftir reynslu, þekkingu og hæfni umsækjanda.
Starfið fellur undir kjarasamning Grafíu.
Vinnutími er frá 08:00 til 16:00 virka daga, en til 15:30 á föstudögum.

Um Prentmet Odda:

Prentmet Oddi er stærsti framleiðandi landsins á kartonumbúðum, almennu prentverki og bókum. Félagið vinnur jafnframt með mörgum af öflugustu umbúðaframleiðendum Evrópu til að veita fyrirtækjum heildarlausnir á sviði umbúða. Prentmet Oddi þjónustar meginþorra af kröfuhörðustu fyrirtækjum landsins og hefur gert það í áratugi með hraða, gæði og persónulega þjónustu að leiðarljósi.

Áhugasamir umsækjendur eru hvattir til að sækja um starf á:

🔹 https://alfred.is/starf/prentari-oskast-6

eða

Nánari upplýsingar má einnig fá með því að senda fyrirspurn á isi@prentmetoddi.is.

Við leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur metnað fyrir gæðum, tæknilega færni og áhuga á að taka þátt í framleiðslu á fyrsta flokks prentverkefnum.

title: Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based (Informatiker/in)
description:
We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation— helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

The Director, Global Service Delivery (f/m/d) - EMEA Based  is a senior leadership role within Global Engineering Services (GES), part of Siemens' Global Technologies & Infrastructure (GTI) organization. This role owns the end-to-end delivery of engineering support services across three global regions — Americas, EMEA, and APAC — serving approximately 17,000 software engineers worldwide. The Director is accountable for service quality, regional consistency, people leadership, and the ongoing transformation of the SD function.

Please send your CV in English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Strategic Leadership

- Define and execute the global Service Delivery strategy aligned with GES and GTI priorities.- Set the vision, operating model (Follow-the-Sun), and performance standards for SD across all three regions.- Lead the annual planning cycle for SD: headcount, budget, initiatives, and OKRs.- Represent the SD function at GES leadership reviews, executive briefings, and cross-functional forums.- Drive continuous improvement in service delivery maturity, tooling, and process standardization.

Operational Excellence

- Own the end-to-end SLO/SLA framework for the SD function globally; ensure targets are met and reported.- Partner with the Global Operations Excellence (GOE) team to enforce standards, monitoring, and governance.- Ensure all regions are aligned on tooling, processes, CMDB accuracy, and asset management practices.- Oversee the successful delivery of global programmes (e.g., PCD migration, device refresh, CMDB clean-up…etc).- Identify operational risks and blockers across regions; escalate and resolve proactively.

People Leadership

- Directly lead three Regional SD Leads (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and maintain accountability for the full SD organization.- Build a high-performing, engaged, and geographically distributed team; develop regional leaders and successors.- Drive talent reviews, performance management, and calibration across the SD function.- Champion a culture of accountability, customer focus, and continuous improvement.

Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Engagement

- Serve as the primary SD point of contact for peer GTI functions.- Build and maintain strong relationships with key business stakeholders.- Collaborate with regional SD leads and managers to address customer escalations and service issues.- Provide regular operational reporting to the Senior Director, GES and GTI leadership.

Engineering Segments Engagement

- Own the customer relationship between GES and engineering segments globally; serve as the primary point of contact for segment leads regarding infrastructure, service quality, and engineering productivity.- Establish and maintain a regular engagement cadence with segment representatives to understand development pipeline needs, CI/CD tooling requirements, and environment pain points.- Proactively identify opportunities to improve developer productivity and engineering experience — including build performance, environment stability, tooling access, and onboarding friction.- Collaborate with SD Leads, GOE, and Architecture & Standards teams to translate segment feedback into actionable service improvements and capacity planning inputs.- Track and report on segments satisfaction, developer productivity trends, and GES contribution to engineering velocity — escalate where GES environment is a constraint on delivery.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE
Required

- Extensive relevant experience in infrastructure management, service delivery, or technology operations, with a significant portion of that time spent in senior leadership — managing global or multi-regional teams at scale.- Proven track record leading large, geographically distributed teams across multiple countries and regions.- Deep understanding of ITSM frameworks (ITIL) and IT governance practices (COBIT or equivalent).- Strong experience managing budgets, headcount planning, and resource allocation at a global scale.- Demonstrated ability to drive transformation programmes and change across complex organizations.- Experience operating in a matrixed, multinational corporate environment.- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; comfortable presenting to executive audiences.- Sound understanding of asset management practices, including CMDB governance, hardware lifecycle management, and software asset inventory at enterprise scale.- Demonstrable knowledge of data center operations and management, including RDC/colocation environments, capacity planning, and infrastructure governance.- Working knowledge of server and storage technologies, including enterprise server platforms, SAN/NAS storage, and backup/recovery frameworks.- Familiarity with vulnerability management processes, including risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination with information security teams to ensure compliance.- Familiarity with software development practices and the software development lifecycle (SDLC); ability to engage credibly with engineering and development teams on environment and tooling requirements.- Working knowledge of CI/CD concepts and common pipeline patterns; exposure to CI/CD platforms, sufficient to understand engineering dependencies and environment requirements.- Understanding of developer workflow tooling and environment needs — including source control, build systems, artifact management, and test infrastructure — as they relate to GES infrastructure provisioning and support.

Preferred

- Background in software engineering, or large-scale enterprise Technology environments.- Hands-on or oversight experience with virtualization technologies (VMware ESXi, OpenStack, or equivalent platforms).- Experience with high-performance or grid computing environments — including job scheduling, compute cluster management, and distributed compute platforms.- Understanding of enterprise networking concepts, sufficient to oversee network-dependent service delivery.- Experience working with or transitioning to cloud-managed or hybrid infrastructure models.- Prior experience in a software engineering, DevOps, or platform engineering role — or significant direct collaboration with software development teams; comfort discussing CI/CD pipelines, build performance, and developer environment requirements.

EDUCATION
Degree — Required

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline.- Degrees in other disciplines will be considered where accompanied by strong relevant experience.

Advanced Education — Preferred

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering Management, or an MBA with a technology focus.

CERTIFICATIONS
IT Service Management & Governance — Preferred

- ITIL v4 Foundation — required; Managing Professional or Strategic Leader tracks highly valued.- COBIT 2019 Foundation or Practitioner — IT governance and control framework knowledge.- ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Auditor — advantageous for security governance oversight.

Project & Programme Management — Advantageous

- PMP (Project Management Professional) — PMI.- PRINCE2 Practitioner or PRINCE2 Agile.

LOCATION & TRAVEL
This is a global role with flexibility on base location.
Regular international travel to regional sites and team face-to-face meetings is expected.

REPORTING STRUCTURE
Reports to: Senior Director, Global Engineering Services (GES)
Direct reports: Regional SD Leads — Americas, EMEA, APAC
Functional scope: Full global SD organization

title: Business Analyst
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Shaw Commercials Group in Castlebar is currently recruiting for Business Analyst position. Reporting to the Managing Director / Operations Manager, the successful candidate will play an important role in the business with have multiple responsibilities and duties that will span across various departments. This is a busy work environment working to weekly and monthly deadlines. Collaborate with business leaders, department heads, and operational teams to understand business needs, challenges, and opportunities and translate them into clear and actionable requirements. Analyse existing business processes, workflows, systems, and reporting structures to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement across business and operational functions. Document, structure, and prioritise business requirements to support the development and implementation of practical, technology-driven solutions. Support and drive continuous improvement initiatives across the organisation, with a focus on improving efficiency, accuracy, cost effectiveness, and overall business performance. Identify opportunities for automation and AI integration across daily, weekly, and monthly reporting and operational processes. Develop and support automated reporting solutions using Microsoft Excel, Power BI, and other reporting or data visualisation tools. Explore and support the introduction of AI-based tools and automation technologies to reduce manual workload in areas including reporting, data entry, scheduling, forecasting, and operational analysis. Work with internal teams and external IT providers to support the design, development, and implementation of business systems and digital solutions. Support system integration activities to ensure new tools and platforms operate effectively with existing business systems, processes, and workflows. Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure business requirements are clearly communicated, understood, and appropriately delivered. Assist with solution design, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support for new systems and business process changes. Develop and enhance management reporting frameworks, dashboards, and performance tracking tools to support effective, data-driven decision-making. Support the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data across reporting and operational systems. Promote appropriate data governance practices, including compliance with GDPR and internal data security requirements. Translate technical concepts into clear business language and communicate business requirements effectively to technical stakeholders. Support training, onboarding, documentation, and change management activities to assist with the successful adoption of new systems, processes, and technologies. Promote continuous improvement and digital innovation across the organisation by identifying and supporting smarter and more efficient ways of working.

title: Facilities Manager
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
We are seeking an experienced and proactive Facilities Manager to oversee the delivery of hard and soft facilities services on site for a major account. This is a hands-on leadership role responsible for managing day-to-day operations, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations, and maintaining high standards of service delivery across multiple stakeholders. You will lead on-site teams, manage contractors, oversee maintenance programmes, and act as the key operational contact for the client. The successful candidate will be a customer-focused facilities professional with strong leadership skills, commercial awareness, and a proven ability to manage operational performance in a fast-paced environment. Key Responsibilities Operational Management Manage the day-to-day delivery of hard and soft facilities services across the contract. Lead, motivate, and develop the on-site service delivery team. Oversee planned preventative maintenance (PPM) schedules and lifecycle replacement programmes. Manage reactive maintenance requests and ensure contractual service levels are achieved. Scope, manage, and verify minor works projects. Coordinate contractors and ensure works are completed safely, efficiently, and to specification. Manage permit-to-work and safe systems of work processes. Client & Stakeholder Management Act as the primary operational point of contact for the client and key stakeholders. Build and maintain strong working relationships through effective communication and service delivery. Attend client meetings and provide operational updates and performance reporting. Resolve issues promptly and professionally while maintaining a customer-focused approach. Health, Safety & Compliance Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation and company policies. Lead safety initiatives including toolbox talks, safety walks, and near-miss reporting. Monitor contractor compliance and site safety performance. Promote a strong culture of safety and continuous improvement across all service lines. Financial & Contract Management Monitor lifecycle expenditure and ensure spending remains within agreed budgets. Manage materials ordering and cost control processes. Support small works estimation and project delivery. Understand and interpret contractual requirements to ensure compliance and value delivery. Administration & Reporting Maintain accurate contract documentation, records, and compliance files. Produce operational, maintenance, and performance reports as required. Coordinate site inductions and onboarding activities. Manage payroll and timekeeping processes for site-based teams. Maintain lifecycle plans, budgets, and performance data. About You Essential Experience & Skills Previous Facilities Management experience in a management or supervisory capacity. Experience managing both hard and soft FM services. Strong people management and leadership skills. Experience working in a client-facing environment. Excellent communication

title: Computer Numerical Control Operatives
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Our client, Fox Bros. Engineering Limited, based in Gorey, Co. Wexford, is currently seeking Computer Numerical Control Operatives for immediate start for their facility in Gorey, Co. Wexford. Qualifications: A minimum of 3 years’ CNC operation experience is required. There are no minimum academic requirements. A CNC or related certification is a plus but is not required. Key Responsibilities - Set up, maintain, and control CNC machines to execute production orders accurately and efficiently. - Program CNC machines, ensuring required parameters, tolerances, and measurements are met while maintaining quality and safety standards. - Monitor automated machines to ensure proper operation and optimal performance. - Perform test runs to verify machine settings and ensure product quality. - Remove processed workpieces and inspect finished products for accuracy and defects. - Remove and report inadequate or non-conforming workpieces. - Set up machine controllers and supply machines with appropriate tools and materials. - Perform routine machine maintenance and troubleshooting as required. - Ensure equipment availability and readiness for scheduled production. - Follow all safety guidelines and company procedures. Key Requirements - Ability to competently perform all job duties listed above - Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience as a CNC Operator in a manufacturing or production environment. - Proven experience reading and interpreting standard blueprints and technical drawings. - Demonstrated experience in machine setup, maintenance, and programming. - Strong understanding of manufacturing processes, quality standards, and Statistical Process Control (SPC). - Ability to consult and interpret technical documentation, blueprints, and drawings. - Experience programming CNC controllers and using automatic programming functions. - Proficiency in CAM software. - Ability to troubleshoot machining issues efficiently. - Competence in operating precision measuring equipment (e.g., calipers, micrometers, gauges). - Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining quality standards. - Good problem-solving and analytical skills. - Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Annual remuneration: €36,605.00; Pay rate €18.05 per hour Work Location: Fox Bros. Engineering Limited, Ballycanew, Gorey. Co. Wexford Number of hours work each week: 39 If you're interested in this role, please apply with an up-to-date CV to info@crewitresourcing.com or call 019020688 to enquire for more details.

description:

Our client, Lenviron Limited t/a Leinster Environmentals, based in Haggardstown, Co. Louth, is currently seeking Plant Mechanics for immediate start for their facility in Haggardstown, Co. Louth. Qualifications: 2-3 years’ Plant Mechanic experience required. Mechanic Certification preferred but not essential. There are no minimum academic requirements. Further training will be provided on-the-job as required. General Duties / Responsibilities / Experience: - To maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and service machinery and equipment used in plant hire, construction and related civils activities - To ensure that all plant machinery is operating efficiently and safely, to minimize downtime, and to support the overall productivity of the plant - To perform regular maintenance checks on plant machinery, including mixers, conveyors, pumps, crushers, and batching systems. - To conduct preventative maintenance tasks to extend the life of equipment and minimize breakdowns. - To lubricate machinery, replace worn parts, and ensure all components are in good working condition. - To identify mechanical, electrical, and hydraulic issues in plant equipment and diagnose problems accurately. - To repair or replace faulty parts, ensuring that all machinery is returned to full operational capacity in a timely manner. - To perform both scheduled and emergency repairs to minimize downtime. - To ensure all work is conducted in compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations. - To maintain accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and inspections performed on plant equipment. - Essential knowledge includes mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, as well as the ability to diagnose and fix issues promptly to ensure smooth plant operations - title: Fabricator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
METAL FABRICATOR / MECHANICAL WORKSHOP TECHNICIAN Beara Iron Works – Eyeries, West Cork, Ireland We are looking for a practical, mechanically minded person to join our small fabrication and repair workshop in West Cork. This is a varied job – not just welding. Our work includes: Structural steel fabrication to EN 1090 standards Steel and stainless-steel fabrication MIG and MMA welding Marine and fishing vessel repairs Plant and machinery repairs Hydraulic repairs Boat trailer manufacture and repairs Cutting, drilling, grinding and fitting Repairing and modifying machinery and structures General mechanical and workshop repairs We are a CE-certified structural steel fabrication company, and our work ranges from structural steel projects to marine repairs and machinery maintenance. The person we're looking for You do not need to be a qualified welder. What matters most to us is that you are a practical, mechanically minded person who enjoys fixing and making things. You should ideally: Have some welding experience Be confident using hand and power tools Understand basic mechanical systems Be able to dismantle and rebuild machinery Be able to measure, cut, drill and fit steel Be able to look at a problem and work out how to repair or modify it Be comfortable working on different types of equipment Be able to work independently Take pride in doing a good job Be willing to learn new skills Experience in metal fabrication, agricultural machinery, plant machinery, marine work, mechanical repairs, engineering or similar trades would be an advantage. Practical ability and experience are more important to us than formal qualifications. Life in West Cork We are located in Eyeries on the Beara Peninsula, right beside the Atlantic coast. The area is ideal for someone who enjoys the outdoors, with excellent opportunities for sea fishing, boating, hiking and exploring the coast. If fishing is your hobby, this is a particularly good place to live – the coast is right on your doorstep. Accommodation can be arranged near the workplace. You will be working in a workshop where every day is different. Rather than doing the same job every day, you will get the opportunity to work on structural steel, boats, machinery, fabrication and mechanical repairs. If you are the type of person who enjoys welding, fixing machinery, working with tools and figuring out how things work, we'd like to hear from you. Please send us a CV or a short description of your experience and the type of work you have done.

title: Plant Mechanics
description:

Our client, Lenviron Limited t/a Leinster Environmentals, based in Haggardstown, Co. Louth, is currently seeking Plant Mechanics for immediate start for their facility in Haggardstown, Co. Louth. Qualifications: 2-3 years’ Plant Mechanic experience required. Mechanic Certification preferred but not essential. There are no minimum academic requirements. Further training will be provided on-the-job as required. General Duties / Responsibilities / Experience: - To maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and service machinery and equipment used in plant hire, construction and related civils activities - To ensure that all plant machinery is operating efficiently and safely, to minimize downtime, and to support the overall productivity of the plant - A mechanic qualification or certificate is a bonus but is not mandatory - 2-3 years’ of proven relevant experience as a Plant Mechanic is required. title: Fabricator
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
METAL FABRICATOR / MECHANICAL WORKSHOP TECHNICIAN Beara Iron Works – Eyeries, West Cork, Ireland We are looking for a practical, mechanically minded person to join our small fabrication and repair workshop in West Cork. This is a varied job – not just welding. Our work includes: Structural steel fabrication to EN 1090 standards Steel and stainless-steel fabrication MIG and MMA welding Marine and fishing vessel repairs Plant and machinery repairs Hydraulic repairs Boat trailer manufacture and repairs Cutting, drilling, grinding and fitting Repairing and modifying machinery and structures General mechanical and workshop repairs We are a CE-certified structural steel fabrication company, and our work ranges from structural steel projects to marine repairs and machinery maintenance. The person we're looking for You do not need to be a qualified welder. What matters most to us is that you are a practical, mechanically minded person who enjoys fixing and making things. You should ideally: Have some welding experience Be confident using hand and power tools Understand basic mechanical systems Be able to dismantle and rebuild machinery Be able to measure, cut, drill and fit steel Be able to look at a problem and work out how to repair or modify it Be comfortable working on different types of equipment Be able to work independently Take pride in doing a good job Be willing to learn new skills Experience in metal fabrication, agricultural machinery, plant machinery, marine work, mechanical repairs, engineering or similar trades would be an advantage. Practical ability and experience are more important to us than formal qualifications. Life in West Cork We are located in Eyeries on the Beara Peninsula, right beside the Atlantic coast. The area is ideal for someone who enjoys the outdoors, with excellent opportunities for sea fishing, boating, hiking and exploring the coast. If fishing is your hobby, this is a particularly good place to live – the coast is right on your doorstep. Accommodation can be arranged near the workplace. You will be working in a workshop where every day is different. Rather than doing the same job every day, you will get the opportunity to work on structural steel, boats, machinery, fabrication and mechanical repairs. If you are the type of person who enjoys welding, fixing machinery, working with tools and figuring out how things work, we'd like to hear from you. Please send us a CV or a short description of your experience and the type of work you have done.

description:
Night Audit

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

- Processing booking requests

title: responsabile di deposito
description: Per Cliente leader nel suo settore di riferimento, siamo alla ricerca di un* RESPONSABILE LOGISTICA. La risorsa, riportando alla Direzione, dovrà: Coordinare un gruppo di circa 10 persone fornendo supporto e supervisione per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Collaborare con altri dipartimenti, come Produzione e Pianificazione, per coordinare la consegna dei materiali ai reparti di produzione e di assemblaggio. Gestire e supervisionare tutte le operazioni logistiche, garantendo l'efficienza e l'accuratezza delle attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e trasferimento dei materiali. Assicurare il corretto ricevimento dei materiali in entrata, effettuando controlli di corrispondenza merce e quantità, garantendo l'integrità delle merci durante il processo di immagazzinamento. Ottimizzare i flussi di trasferimento dei materiali tra i due siti produttivi, definendo le opportune regole di gestione che possano correttamente bilanciare le esigenze di disponibilità dei materiali nelle aree produttive con la frequenza dei navettaggi. Supervisionare la gestione degli inventari, eseguendo controlli regolari per garantire l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvere eventuali discrepanze o errori. Utilizzare software avanzati per la gestione del magazzino, come i magazzini verticali, al fine di migliorare l'efficienza e l'automazione delle operazioni. Raccogliere e analizzare in modo strutturato con l'ausilio delle metodologie e degli strumenti più avanzati i dati relativi ai flussi fisici nelle diverse aree aziendali (accettazione, stoccaggio, reparti e bordo linee) al fine di proporre azioni di ottimizzazione volte all'eliminazione di eventuali attività a non valore aggiunto e alla riduzione di eventuali sprechi. Mappare e analizzare i flussi informativi a livello di sistema gestionale (ERP) e sistemi dipartimentali (WMS/magazzini automatici) con l'obiettivo di individuare possibili miglioramenti che rendano più completi e veloci i trasferimenti delle informazioni. Monitorare e garantire il rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza e sulle pratiche di lavoro corrette nel magazzino. Gestire la manutenzione delle attrezzature e degli impianti del magazzino, compresi magazzini verticali e muletti. Coordinare le attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, garantendo che le attrezzature siano in buone condizioni e che siano effettuate eventuali riparazioni o sostituzioni necessarie. REQUISITI Esperienza pregressa nella gestione di magazzini in realtà strutturate (meglio se operanti su commessa), preferibilmente caratterizzate dalla presenza di sistemi automatizzati (come magazzini verticali) e dall'utilizzo di software dipartimentali (tipo WMS - Warehouse Management Systems). Ottima capacità organizzativa per pianificare le attività logistiche e coordinare le risorse che a lui rispondono. Conoscenza delle best practice nella gestione del magazzino, inclusi processi di stoccaggio e movimentazione dei materiali. Leadership comprovata, con esperienza nella gestione di un team e nella delega di compiti. Capacità di analisi e problem-solving per identificare inefficienze, implementare soluzioni e migliorare i processi operativi. Familiarità con gli strumenti informatici utilizzati per l'analisi dei dati e capacità di elaborazione di report. Ottime competenze comunicative e capacità di collaborare con altri dipartimenti per garantire una gestione integrata delle operazioni. Familiarità con le normative sulla sicurezza e la salute sul lavoro relative alle attività di magazzino. RAL: 40-55K Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen

- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
