title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

title: Junior Structural Analyst
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, as we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary.

You can familiarize yourself with Wärtsilä here: https://www.wartsila.com/. For more information about the recruitment process, please contact aTalents Managing Recruitment Consultant Roosa Lönnqvist (+358 50 421 0255, roosa.lonnqvist\[at\]atalent.fi).

**Company description**

_Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Through sustainable technology and data-driven innovation, Wärtsilä enables its customers to improve environmental and economic performance while accelerating the transition towards a more sustainable future. Operating in more than 70 countries and employing thousands of professionals worldwide, Wärtsilä is committed to shaping the decarbonization of the marine and energy industries through innovation, collaboration, and operational excellence._

title: Structural Analysis Expert
description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

- Experience with CFD or multiphysics simulations

- Experience developing simulation methods, processes, or analysis tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Solve varied structural analysis challenges, from focused simulations to complex investigations requiring deeper technical analysis.

- Shape simulation methods and ways of working, giving you opportunities to influence how structural analysis is developed and applied.

- Apply your expertise to engineering decisions that directly support the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies.

- Collaborate across an international R&D environment where experienced specialists actively share methods, findings, and technical knowledge.

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: SSAB - Technical Development Manager Italy
description:
Your qualifications
•    Master’s degree in Mechanical engineering, Metallurgy or Mining
•    Fluent Italian and English written and spoken, German is a merit
•    Experience from the steel industry is a merit
•    Analytical skills
We are currently looking for a Technical Development Manager to SSAB Special Steels in Italy.

About the position
SSAB is a highly-specialized global steel company driven by close customer relationships. SSAB Develops high-strength steels and provides services for better perfomance and sustainability. The company is a leading producer on the global market for Advanced High-Strength Steels (AHSS) and Quenched & Tempered Steel (Q&T), strip, plate and tubular products, as well as construction solutions.
As Technical Development Manager, you are playing an important role of supporting SSAB’s customers with your technical competence and support in order to build customer value and profitability. The role also includes close collaboration with Tech support, product development, production and quality. Your geographical business area will be Italy, Greece and Switzerland. You will be traveling approximately 3-4 days a week to meet customers and also to visit SSAB’s mill in Oxelösund, Sweden.

Application
Send your application no later than 24th of September 2018

In this recruitment we collaborate with Hudson.

For more information, please contact
Fredrik Ålund, Researcher, 076-631 94 44

We decline contacts from recruitment agencies and ad sellers regarding this advertisement.
SSAB is a Nordic and US-based steel company. SSAB offers value added products and services developed in close cooperation with its customers to create a stronger, lighter and more sustainable world. SSAB has employees in over 50 countries. SSAB has production facilities in Sweden, Finland and the US. SSAB is listed on the NASDAQ OMX Nordic Exchange in Stockholm and has a secondary listing on the NASDAQ OMX in Helsinki. www.ssab.com

title: Mystery Shopper in Latvia
description:
Mystery Shopper in Latvia

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest,
reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

title: Mystery Shopper in Lithuania
description:
Mystery Shopper in Lithuania

Work tasks: WHAT OUR MYSTERY SHOPPERS DO
Mystery shoppers do not need to be customer service experts, as their personal opinion is not the deciding factor. However, they must be able to assess customer interactions and the service process objectively. We measure how closely employees’ customer service aligns with their company’s service standards and expectations, enabling businesses to identify development needs and provide targeted training. At the same time, we are confident that our mystery shoppers gradually become customer service professionals themselves. We believe this experience increases their value in the job market, especially in customer-facing roles, as we continuously train and guide our mystery shoppers. Our mystery shoppers are welcome to include “Trendline Mystery Shopper” on their CV. For many employers, this demonstrates a solid understanding of customer service processes. WHAT A TRENDLINE MYSTERY SHOPPER DOES NOT DO Trendline mystery shoppers do not provoke or deliberately challenge employees with difficult or misleading questions. Our mystery shoppers visit service providers, banks, retail stores, and sales organizations. The objective is for the mystery shopper to behave like an ordinary customer. This means they do not ask unusual questions that a typical customer would not ask and do not attempt to provoke employees in any way. Mystery shopping visits are conducted according to scenarios provided by Trendline. After each visit, the mystery shopper submits a detailed report through the Trendline online platform.

We offer: https://trendline.lt
Over 25 years of experience in developing customer service and sales organizations. We operate in Estonia, Latvia, and Lithuania. Our services include: mystery shopping, training, customer satisfaction surveys and feedback questionnaires, development of customer service standards, production of training videos, and internal audit tools for managers. We provide our clients with a comprehensive solution—from defining customer service standards and principles to employee training and measuring implementation and performance.

Other requirements: WHAT QUALITIES WE LOOK FOR
A mystery shopper should be responsible, friendly, honest, reliable, and willing to follow instructions carefully while maintaining a professional approach. Before applying for assignments, our mystery shoppers can review the available projects, including the scenario, evaluation questionnaire, job description, and compensation. Once an assignment is confirmed, they are free to complete the mystery shopping visit at any convenient time within the specified timeframe. After completing the visit, the mystery shopper submits a concise evaluation report through the mystery shopper module of our online platform. Our mystery shoppers always have access to our dedicated Mystery Shopper Support Service, which provides ongoing assistance to help them complete assignments to a high standard. Upon request, we also offer additional training, as well as technical and practical support. With more than 25 years of experience in training and customer service development, Trendline knows how to focus on what matters most and provides high-quality training for all mystery shoppers.

Option to work from home: Yes

title: Research Facilitator (m/f)
description:
Research Facilitator

(Valid from 03/09/2026 to 18/02/2027)

Language: English (UK)
Location: Esch-sur-Alzette
Country: Luxembourg

Organisation data: Research Support department

Job Number: UOL08436
Contract Type: Permanent
Schedule Type: Full Time
Work Hours 40.0 Hours per Week
Expected Start Date: 01/11/2026

Role Type: Open Position
Functions: Research support
Expertise: Research & Education Support
Job (internal): Research facilitator
Job Level: level 1

About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply

Applications should include:

• Curriculum Vitae
• Cover letter

Early application is highly encouraged, as the applications will be processed upon reception. Please apply ONLINE formally through the HR system. Applications by Email will not be considered.
All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply. In line with our values, the University of Luxembourg promotes an inclusive culture. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and are dedicated to upholding equality and respect for our employees and students.

title: Expert en informatique et cybersécurité (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Missions Pilotage stratégique et budgétaire: Contribuer à la définition de la feuille de route du service informatique, en alignement avec le plan de développement du CTIE et les enjeux métiers de l'administration; Élaborer et suivre le budget IT : allocation des ressources, priorisation des investissements (matériels, logiciels, services) et optimisation des coûts; Participer à la gouvernance IT : garantir la cohérence des choix technologiques avec les normes et standards étatiques (ex. : RGPD, référentiels ANSSI). Gestion des contrats et marchés publics: Superviser les contrats de maintenance des logiciels métiers : négociation, renouvellement et suivi des SLA avec les éditeurs/prestataires; Piloter des marchés publics pour l'acquisition de matériel informatique (appels d'offres, cahiers des charges, sélection des fournisseurs). Cybersécurité et conformité réglementaire: Cartographier et évaluer les risques cybersécurité spécifiques à l'ACT (Analyse des menaces et vulnérabilités, scénarios d'attaques, etc.); Mettre en œuvre la directive NIS2: Audit des systèmes existants et plan d'actions pour la conformité; Sensibilisation des équipes et coordination avec les parties prenant/antes (DSI, etc.); Gérer les incidents de sécurité : protocoles de réponse, communication de crise et retour d'expérience; Appliquer et faire évoluer les politiques de sécurité (PSSI, procédures internes, bonnes pratiques). Déployer une solution de monitoring centralisée (supervision des performances, alertes, tableaux de bord); Maintenir la documentation technique à jour (schémas d'architecture, procédures, inventaires). Veille et innovation: Assurer une veille technologique et réglementaire (évolutions NIS2, menaces cybersécurité, tendances DevOps); Proposer des améliorations : automatisation, résilience ou nouvelles solutions alignées avec les besoins métiers. Profil Compétences techniques Compétences métiers: Savoir appliquer la matier/ière, la législation et la réglementation du domaine concerné ainsi que posséder des connaissances en matier/ière de protection des données; Savoir faire une analyse fonctionnelle et technique des systèmes informatiques; Connaître la méthodologie associée à la gestion des opérations informatiques (ITIL) (Information Technology Insfrastructure Library); Connaître les partenaires et intervenants dans les processus liés aux systèmes informatiques; Disposer de connaissances informatiques approfondies (réseaux, administration de systèmes, bases de données, applications web, développement, bonnes pratiques en matier/ière de sécurité, sauvegarde des données, etc.); Vous savez comprendre le fonctionnement des architectures et technologies IT, en apprécier les risques potentiels au niveau technique et assister à la mise en place selon les bonnes pratiques en termes d'hygiène informatique; Disposer de connaissances ou expériences pratiques dans les domaines liés à la l'exploitation de systèmes, réseaux et virtualisation; Connaître les outils Kubernetes, Rancher, Docker; Disposer de connaissances en sécurité informatique; Avoir une bonne compréhension des architectures SAN/NAS; Avoir une expérience en administration de systèmes Linux; Avoir une expérience en scripting (Bash/Python/Powershell) ainsi que disposer des connaissances des outils d'automatisation. Compétences support: Savoir travailler de façon autonome mais également en équipe pluridisciplinaire; Être un bon communicateur; Disposer de bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et orales; Être doté de fortes compétences d'analyse et savoir gérer les priorités; Avoir les capacités d'appréhender et capacité d'analyse...

title: Expert Ressources Humaines (m/f) (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Le Centre commun de la sécurité sociale (CCSS) est un établissement public en charge notamment: De l'affiliation à la sécurité sociale des salariés, travailleurs indépendants et assurés volontaires; Du calcul, de la perception et du recouvrement des cotisations sociales; De la répartition des cotisations sociales entre les différentes institutions de la sécurité sociale telles que l'AAA, la CNS, la CNAP. Le CCSS offre un cadre de travail motivant: En mettant en œuvre une mission légale essentielle pour le Luxembourg; En étant installé dans un bâtiment moderne; En étant localisé idéalement en face de la gare de Luxembourg à proximité immédiate de tous les moyens de transports, dans un quartier en renouveau et facile d'accès; En offrant la formation initiale complétée par la formation continue offerte à tous les agents du service public; En offrant une rémunération en ligne avec les conditions de la Fonction publique. Missions En tant qu'expert RH au sein du service ressources humaines du CCSS, vous rapportez directement au responsable RH. Vous l'assistez en participant activement à la gestion opérationnelle des ressources humaines du CCSS et jouez un rôle de conseiller auprès des agents et des supérieurs hiérarchiques. Vous participez aux projets RH définis dans le programme de travail et intervenez tout au long du cycle de vie RH des agents. Plus concrètement, vos missions consistent à: Accompagner et conseiller les agents dans leur évolution de carrier/ière; Fournir un support aux responsables d'unités organisationnelles dans toutes les problématiques RH et/ou organisationnelles; Organiser les examens de fin de stage, examens de promotion et de carrier/ière; Participer activement au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux agents; Accompagner le développement des compétences des agents; Participer aux projets RH définis dans le programme de travail; Développer les processus RH et contribuer à l'amélioration continue des processus en place; Gérer les obligations légales et statutaires liées au domaine RH; Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les collègues du service RH et le responsable RH. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience professionnelle d'au moins années, dont 5 ans minimum au sein d'un service RH dans une fonction similaire; Excellente connaissance du statut du fonctionnaire et du régime des employés et des salariés de l'Etat; Connaissance des différents processus et procédures touchant le cycle de vie RH dans la fonction publique; Connaissance des obligations liées à la protection des données (RGPD) dans la gestion des dossiers individuels; Excellente capacité à conduire un entretien individuel et fournir un conseil RH; Connaissance des principes de gestion de projet; Capacité à structurer, documenter et améliorer les processus RH; Connaissance adaptée des langues administratives; Bonne maîtrise des outils bureautiques courants. Compétences comportementales Innover : penser de manier/ière innovant/ante, apporter des idées créatives pour améliorer l'existant, encourager l'innovation; Gérer les activités : gérer les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs clairs, gérer les ressources et suivre la mise en œuvre des activités; Soutenir : agir comme référence, accompagner les collègues, les guider et les soutenir en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : fournir des conseils et développer une relation de confiance basée sur sa crédibilité, faire des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client usager; Gérer les stress : Garder son calme face à la pression, rester constructif face à la critique et agir de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Être ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, s'ouvrir à la diversité et s'intéresser à d'autres disciplines que les sien/iennes; S'autodévelopper : Bien se connaître, se remettre en question de façon régulier/ière, apprendre de ses erreurs et apprendre continuellement; S'impliquer : S'engager pour générer des résultats, assumer la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, s'engager pour le bien commun. Atouts Expérience réussie dans un service RH au sein du secteur public luxembourgeois; Connaissance des outils de la fonction publique luxembourgeoise (Toolbox, MyRH, SAP). Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission : Pour devenir fonctionnaire de l'État Pour changer d'administration en tant que fonctionnaire Pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement...

title: Cartographe (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? La Bibliothèque nationale du Luxembourg (BnL) s'engage dans un nouveau programme visant à améliorer l'accessibilité de ses collections, en particulier celles des Fonds spéciaux, qui abritent des trésors patrimoniaux uniques : cartes historiques, plans, atlas, vues topographiques et documents cartographiques rares. Avec cartes et plans couvrant des représentations du monde, du Luxembourg et de ses territoires, cette collection se distingue comme l'une des plus remarquables du pays. Pourtant, cette collection reste non cataloguée, donc inaccessible en ligne. La BnL cherche à renforcer l'équipe patrimoniale avec un expert polyvalent, capable de gérer des tâches complexes liées à la préservation et à l'accessibilité du patrimoine. Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Conservation et expertise: Assurer la préservation des documents (conditions de stockage, restauration si nécessaire); Participer à des projets de recherche en lien avec les collections, en collaboration avec des institutions nationales ou internationales. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience avérée en: Catalogage de documents patrimoniaux (normes RDA, Rameau, DDC); Gestion de SIGB (idéalement Alma); Numérisation et valorisation de collections spéciales; Maîtrise des outils de traitement d'images, de métadonnées et de bases de données bibliographiques; Connaissances en conservation préventive des documents anciens et fragiles; Rigueur et précision : capacité à travailler avec des documents uniques et parfois fragiles; Esprit d'initiative : proposition de solutions innovant/antes pour améliorer l'accessibilité des collections; Collaboration : travail en équipe avec les autres services de la BnL (patrimoine, IT, communication); Sens de la médiation : aptitude à rendre les collections compréhensibles et attractives pour le public. Compétences comportementales Conceptualiser : Vous pensez de façon abstraite à l'aide de concepts, vous modélisez et simulez le futur pour concevoir des solutions réalistes; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulier/ière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Atouts Connaissance du contexte luxembourgeois (histoire, géographie, institutions culturelles); Expérience dans la gestion de projets liés au patrimoine ou à la numérisation. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Inspection du travail et des mines - Service Dialogue Social et Élections Sociales Missions Garantir une assistance pour les unités organisationnelles: Assurer une assistance au niveau de l'accueil et téléphonique; Veiller au respect des normes en matier/ière de sécurité et de au travail, en matier/ière d'établissements classés et autres matier/ières tombant sous les compétences de l'administration; Traitement des matier/ières de délégation du personnel et autres formes de représentation du personnel, d'élections sociales, de dialogue social, de harcèlement moral, sexuel et discriminatoire, d'égalité de traitement, de durée du travail et de droit à la déconnexion; Conseiller et assister les salariés, les employeurs et autres intervenants en matier/ière de conditions de travail, de sécurité et au travail, d'établissements classés et toutes autres matier/ières tombant sous les compétences de l'administration; Effectuer des contrôles, respectivement des inspections en matier/ière de conditions de travail, de sécurité publique, de sécurité et au travail, d'établissements classés et toutes autres matier/ières tombant sous les compétences de l'administration; Proposer à sa hiérarchie les mesures à ordonner, respectivement ordonner soi-même les mesures nécessaires aux fins de régularisation des non-conformité, infractions, etc. constatées; Gérer, traiter, analyser et assurer le suivi des dossiers et projets; Organiser, respectivement participer aux réunions relatives aux dossiers et projets à gérer; Rédiger les courriers et autres documents en relation avec les dossiers et projets traités; Identifier les manquements, respectivement déficiences, effectuer des propositions d'amélioration, élaborer et participer à la mise à jour des dispositions légales, réglementaires, administratives et des documents techniques (conditions types, etc.) nécessaires au bon déroulement des tâches de l'administration. title: Gestionnaire de projet (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? L'Administration des contributions directes (ACD) recherche deux Gestionnaires de projet pour renforcer son Bureau de gestion des projets et contribuer activement à ses projets de transformation et de modernisation. Missions Au sein du Bureau de gestion des projets, vous serez amené(e) à : Conduire et coordonner les initiatives de changement imposées par la réglementation ou par la stratégie, visant à moderniser et optimiser l'administration; Jouer un rôle clé dans la structuration et la gouvernance des projets, garantissant leur alignement avec la vision et les objectifs de l'administration; Veiller à la bonne conduite des projets en anticipant les risques, en facilitant la collaboration entre les différentes parties prenant/antes et en s'assurant de l'adoption des nouvelles pratiques, en interaction avec les équipes métiers, les équipes de support (telles que IT ou RH) et la direction; Assurer le déploiement des nouveaux processus et outils, tout en accompagnant les équipes dans la transition; Appliquer la législation et la réglementation du domaine concerné, ainsi que les règles de l'administration en matier/ière de protection des données et de sécurité de l'information; Comprendre le contexte spécifique des projets et leurs impacts stratégiques sur l'administration; Maitriser l'organisation, les procédures et processus internes liés à la gestion de projet. Dans cette fonction, vous aurez l'opportunité d'intervenir sur plusieurs projets en parallèle, au sein d'équipes multidisciplinaires et dans un contexte où les priorités peuvent évoluer rapidement. Profil Compétences techniques Vous disposez d'une premier/ière expérience professionnelle, idéalement de 3 à 5, ans au cours de laquelle vous avez démontré votre capacité d'initiative et votre sens des responsabilités. Compétences comportementales Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à : Comprendre des situations complexes, les analyser et proposer des solutions pragmatiques; Structurer et conduire des projets de manier/ière méthodique; Accompagner le changement et favoriser l'adhésion des parties prenant/antes; Travailler de manier/ière collaborative et coordonner efficacement différents intervenants; Développer des relations de confiance et formuler des recommandations pertinentes. Vous vous distinguez également par : Une réelle motivation à développer vos compétences en gestion de projet; Une forte capacité d'apprentissage et d'adaptation; D'excellentes aptitudes de communication et de négociation; Un sens aigu du relationnel et de l'écoute; Une approche de travail rigoureur/euse, organisée et orientée résultats; Une bonne gestion du stress et des priorités. Atouts Une expérience ou des connaissances en matier/ière de rédaction et de suivi des marchés publics; Connaissances dans le domaine de la fiscalité; Maîtrise de la langue luxembourgeoise. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut de l'employé de l'État. Obtenez plus de détails sur les conditions d'admission pour devenir employé de l'État. Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en économie, management, gestion d'entreprises, gestion de projet, transformation digitale, ingénierie ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Expérience Vous avez une expérience d'au moins 3 ans dans le domaine. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences des connaissances de 3 langues administratives pour le groupe d'indemnité A1. Une dispense de deux des trois langues administratives peut être accordée sous certaines conditions.  Vous êtes ressortissant d'un État membre de l'Union européenne.

Missions Catalogage et valorisation des collections: Enrichir les métadonnées, référencer, cataloguer, indexer et exemplariser les documents des Fonds spéciaux, surtout les cartes, plans, atlas, vues, selon les normes en vigueur (SIGB Alma, RDA, Rameau, DDC); Structurer les critères de collection pour les documents cartographiques, en collaboration avec l'équipe patrimoniale; Établir une charte d'acquisition et une politique de conservation adaptées aux spécificités des fonds cartographiques; Contrôler la cohérence du développement du Fonds des cartes, plans et atlas, en veillant à son alignement avec les objectifs stratégiques de la BnL. Gestion et accessibilité numérique: Piloter la numérisation des collections cartographiques; Valoriser les collections à l'aide des nouvelles technologies (humanités numériques, outils de recherche scientifique) pour en faciliter l'accès au public et aux chercheurs; Collaborer avec les services IT pour intégrer les données cartographiques dans les plateformes numériques de la BnL (eluxemburgensia). Conservation et expertise: Assurer la préservation des documents (conditions de stockage, restauration si nécessaire); Participer à des projets de recherche en lien avec les collections, en collaboration avec des institutions nationales ou internationales. Profil Compétences techniques Expérience avérée en: Catalogage de documents patrimoniaux (normes RDA, Rameau, DDC); Gestion de SIGB (idéalement Alma); Numérisation et valorisation de collections spéciales; Maîtrise des outils de traitement d'images, de métadonnées et de bases de données bibliographiques; Connaissances en conservation préventive des documents anciens et fragiles; Rigueur et précision : capacité à travailler avec des documents uniques et parfois fragiles; Esprit d'initiative : proposition de solutions innovant/antes pour améliorer l'accessibilité des collections; Collaboration : travail en équipe avec les autres services de la BnL (patrimoine, IT, communication); Sens de la médiation : aptitude à rendre les collections compréhensibles et attractives pour le public. Compétences comportementales Conceptualiser : Vous pensez de façon abstraite à l'aide de concepts, vous modélisez et simulez le futur pour concevoir des solutions réalistes; Gérer les activités : Vous gérez les activités courant/antes au travers d'objectifs opérationnels clairs, vous gérez les ressources et suivez la mise en oeuvre des activités; Soutenir : Vous agissez comme référence, vous accompagnez les collègues, vous les guidez et les soutenez en stimulant la coopération autour de l'objectif commun; Conseiller : Vous fournissez des conseils et développez une relation de confiance basée sur votre crédibilité, vous faites des recommandations dans l'intérêt de l'organisation et du client-usager; Faire preuve d'ouverture : Vous êtes ouvert au changement et à l'innovation, vous vous ouvrez à la diversité et vous vous intéressez à d'autres disciplines que les vôtres; Gérer le stress : Vous gardez votre calme face à la pression, vous restez constructif face à la critique et vous agissez de façon constant/ante malgré les difficultés; S'autodévelopper : Vous vous remettez en question de façon régulier/ière, vous apprenez de vos erreurs et vous apprenez continuellement; S'impliquer : Vous vous engagez pour générer des résultats, vous assumez la responsabilité et la qualité des actions entreprises, vous vous engagez pour le bien commun. Atouts Connaissance du contexte luxembourgeois (histoire, géographie, institutions culturelles); Expérience dans la gestion de projets liés au patrimoine ou à la numérisation. Conditions d'admission Le poste peut être brigué sous le statut du fonctionnaire de l'État ou de l'employé de l'État. Il est ouvert au changement d'administration des fonctionnaires. title: Médecin militaire (m/f) (H/F)
description: Statut : Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? L'Armée luxembourgeoise est une force militaire moderne et professionnelle. Composée d'hommes et de femmes dévoués, elle a pour mission principale de défendre la souveraineté et l'intégrité du Grand-Duché, de contribuer à la sécurité nationale et internationale, et de participer aux opérations de maintien de la paix sous l'égide de l'OTAN, de l'Union européenne et des Nations Unies. Engagée dans un environnement multinational, l'Armée luxembourgeoise offre un cadre de travail où l'esprit d'équipe et le sens du devoir occupent une place centrale. Rejoindre l'Armée luxembourgeoise, c'est: Servir son pays dans un cadre porteur de valeurs fortes : droiture, engagement et fiabilité; Développer ses compétences à travers une formation continue et personnalisée; Évoluer dans une carrier/ière riche en opportunité et missions variées. Missions Le médecin militaire est le dernier maillon de la chaîne e sur le terrain des opérations, après le Combat Med et l'infirmier militaire; En mission, il est capable de prendre en charge des militaires blessés dans toutes les conditions; Sa formation lui permet d'appliquer ses compétences es dans un environnement militaire soumis à des contraintes tactiques et logistiques. Selon sa spécialisation, il peut exercer: En Role 1 : prise en charge visant à garantir la survie du patient dans des conditions dégradées, selon le principe du damage control resuscitation; En Role 2 : prise en charge incluant une capacité chirurgicale d'urgence, reposant sur le damage control surgery, privilégiant la rapidité et le contrôle des lésions vitales plutôt que leur réparation définitive immédiate; Pour entretenir ses compétences cliniques, le médecin militaire exerce également dans le domaine clinique civil. Profil Compétences techniques Être déployable pour toutes les missions et formations de l'Armée; Suivre les formations nécessaires; Maîtriser les outils bureautiques de base; Avoir de bonnes connaissances des opérations et missions de l'Armée luxembourgeoise; Avoir des connaissances de base en gestion des ressources humaines et logistiques. Compétences comportementales Faire preuve de sollicitude, de justice et d'impartialité; Donner l'exemple par la façon de se comporter et d'accomplir ses devoirs; Être ouvert aux relations interpersonnelles; Faire preuve de compétences de leadership; Faire preuve de professionnalisme; Adhérer aux valeurs-phares de l'Armée (engagement-droiture-fiabilité). Conditions d'admission Diplômes Vous êtes titulaire d'un grade ou diplôme délivré par un établissement d'enseignement supérieur reconnu par l'État du siège de l'établissement et sanctionnant l'accomplissement avec succès d'un master en Médecin spécialiste en traumatologie et médecine d'urgence ou de son équivalent. Le grade ou diplôme requis doit correspondre au moins au niveau 7 tel que défini par le Cadre luxembourgeois des qualifications. Vous disposez de l'autorisation d'exercer la profession. Langues Vous répondez aux exigences de connaissances des 3 langues administratives pour le groupe de traitement A1.  Vous avez la  luxembourgeoise. Être reconnu ement et psychologiquement apte pour le service militaire. Avoir une présentation compatible avec l'exercice de la fonction et le port d'uniforme.   Examen-concours: Examen-concours au Centre militaire du  au  octobre  Épreuve sportive, épreuves de langues, tests psychotechniques, épreuve de connaissances générales, évaluation psychologique et entretien de motivation. title: Agent de permanence (m/f) (réf. E) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé de l'État Qui recrute ? Nos services couvrent tous les domaines IT, découvrez nos missions sur notre site internet https://ctie.gouvernement.lu/fr/l-administration.html. Nous offrons: Un environnement technologique varié et favorable à l'innovation; Des projets d'envergure nationale / européenne au service des citoyens; Des projets centrés sur les utilisateurs; Une atmosphère collégiale, dynamique et multilingue; Une administration qui valorise les compétences des collaborateurs et encourage la mobilité interne. About us

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The mission of the Research Support Department is to support the University's aim to pursuit research at the highest international standard, by working in partnership with its researchers to secure, manage and increase funding from external organisations globally, nationally and regionally. This Department communicates the University of Luxembourg's Research Strategy and Policy. The Research Support Department is responsible for providing an effective, efficient and proactive support structure to help and advice researchers on project acquisition, research execution, research management, result dissemination and exploitation. To that end, it gathers and distributes relevant information, proactively identifies sources of research funding, organises training, develops procedures and guidelines in line with the University of Luxembourg's research strategy, and develops and fosters relationships with funding agencies, other research organisations and potential sponsors.

Your role

As a Research Facilitator, you will join a collaborative team working closely with researchers and colleagues across the University. You will work within established processes and contribute to their continuous improvement to meet evolving funding, regulatory and institutional requirements.

Responsibilities:

• Support researchers in identifying national, European and international funding opportunities, e.g. FNR, Horizon Europe and other competitive funding schemes e.g. US funding, with a strong focus on quality control for national funding, e.g. FNR
• Provide a solid understanding of the project management lifecycle of research grants to provide guidance throughout the grant lifecycle, from proposal preparation to project implementation and reporting
• Produce guidelines, checklist for funding instruments and ensure regular updates and optimization of relevant communication channels and platforms
• Perform institutional validation, quality control and compliance reviews of funding applications, ensuring compliance with funders' and institutional requirements
• Contribute to the dissemination of funding opportunities, policies, procedures, and good practices within the research and research support community via relevant communication channels and platforms
• Support the optimization of digital service delivery for the performance of institutional validation, quality control, and compliance processes
• Support the organization of information sessions, workshops, training activities, and networking events
• Liaise with funding agencies, and relevant internal stakeholders and external stakeholders
• Support the institutional validation, monitoring and reporting of research projects and funding-related activities
• Maintain accurate records and contribute to the effective management of research information and data via various systems, e.g. Common Research Information System, Power BI Reports
• Contribute to the development, review and continuous improvement of processes, tools, and guidelines
• Work collaboratively with all central services, Research Facilitators across Faculties and Interdisciplinary Centres to share knowledge and promote best practices
• Contribute to the delivery of efficient, proactive, and service-oriented research facilitation services

Your profile

• Master's degree or equivalent experience
• Strong interest in research, research funding, grant management, process improvements, digital service delivery, and the higher education environment
• Service-oriented mindset with strong problem-solving abilities
• Strong organisational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
• Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and meet deadlines
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy
• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively in a multicultural environment
• Demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a collaborative team
• Ability to build constructive working relationships with a wide range of stakeholders
• Previous experience in research administration, project coordination, grant preparation and management, business process improvements , digital service delivery, and research funding would be considered an advantage
• Familiarity with research funding programmes such as FNR and Horizon Europe would be considered an asset
• Excellent command in English (C1) is required. Good working knowledge of French and/or German (B1) is considered an advantage

We offer

• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities

title: Project Manager (m/f)
description:
Your mission

As a Project Manager, you will lead selected cross-functional projects from initiation through to successful delivery.

Working closely with teams across R&D, Production, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, IT and other key functions, you will ensure that projects are delivered in line with their technical, quality, cost and timing objectives.

Your role will be to provide structure, coordination and leadership throughout the project lifecycle while anticipating risks, solving complex issues and ensuring effective communication between all stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities

Project planning and organization

You will be responsible for structuring and organizing projects to ensure clear objectives and efficient execution:

    Set up and maintain project structures, including project timelines, team organization, budgets and resource planning

    Develop detailed project plans covering milestones, work plans, critical paths, risk management, cost and benefit analysis, staffing requirements and budgets

    Define, agree on and cascade project objectives to all relevant stakeholders

    Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure that everyone works towards common objectives

    Organize project meetings and key review sessions, including technical reviews and launch readiness reviews

    Assign and coordinate the activities required from the different functions involved in the project

    Monitor project progress and follow up on the completion of actions to ensure the project is delivered on time


Project coordination and prioritization

In a dynamic environment where multiple requests and priorities may arise simultaneously, you will play a key role in ensuring that project resources are focused on the right activities:

    Analyze, filter and prioritize incoming requests based on project priorities, business needs and available resources

    Ensure that the prioritization of customer requests is aligned and agreed upon with the Sales team

    Manage competing priorities and support teams in maintaining focus on the most critical activities

    Coordinate the different departments involved in the project, including Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, IT and Sales

    Ensure alignment between project requirements, operational capabilities and available resources


Project performance and risk management

You will actively monitor project performance and identify potential risks before they impact project delivery:

    Systematically identify, assess and manage technical, financial, operational and project-related risks

    Develop and coordinate appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

    Monitor project performance against customer and internal targets

    Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, development budgets, cost objectives and project milestones

    Manage project cost calculations in collaboration with Purchasing, Production and Controlling

description:

title: Junior Auditor (m/f/d)
description:
Description de tâches:


Join our Audit Recruitment Days – 22 and 23 October 2026


Make your mark:

Forget the traditional job interview process. KPMG Luxembourg's Audit Recruitment Days are a two-day immersive experience  designed to give you a real feel for what it means to be an Auditor at KPMG. Through interactive challenges, innovative assessment activities you'll get the chance to explore how modern audit is evolving while also getting to know our people, our culture and life in Luxembourg, all while being considered for a career opportunity at KPMG Luxembourg..

Audit is evolving rapidly. Emerging technologies, data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) are transforming the profession, creating exciting opportunities for curious minds who combine strong business understanding with a passion for innovation.

Whether your background is in Accounting, Finance, Business, Engineering or Technology, the Recruitment Days will allow you to experience how modern Audit combines professional judgment, technology and collaboration to create trust.


What to expect:

Day 1 - Step into #TeamBlue: You'll start the day at our KPMG Luxembourg headquarters where you'll kick things off with interactive presentations about KPMG and the world of Audit. After lunch, you'll dive into the Audit Tech Challenge, a collaborative activity that gives you a real taste of modern Audit in action. In the afternoon, you'll get to discover Luxembourg through a fun team-based urban rally. The day will end with a special networking dinner with our Partners and Service Line Leaders before returning to your accommodation for the night, provided by KPMG.

Day 2 - Time to shine: This is where you'll show your strengths and take part in your a business interview with our Audit professionals. Following the interview, you'll get to participate in an engaging Virtual Reality Cchallenge, meet our people in a lively speed-networking session, and have an exclusive office tour. We'll wrap the day up with lunch followed by a closing session, where a few surprises and highlights await!

The following week, you'll receive feedback because we value transparency and growth! If the outcome is positive, you will also receive a job offer to join KPMG Luxembourg.


Your future role:

As a Junior Auditor, you'll do much more than just review financial information.

You'll combine audit expertise with technology, data and innovation to help clients build trust in an increasingly digital world. Your responsibilities will include:

Applying your accounting and finance knowledge to real client engagements using IFRS, Luxembourg GAAP and international auditing standards.  
Working alongside experienced auditors to understand business processes, identify risks and deliver high-quality audits.  
Leveraging data, technology and emerging AI-enabled tools to support audit procedures and improve efficiency.  
Collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to solve complex business challenges.  
Contributing to innovative projects that improve audit methodologies, data analytics and digital transformation.  
Continuously developing both your audit expertise and your digital capabilities throughout your career.


Who we're looking for:

We're looking for ambitious, sharp-minded people who are ready to grow and make an impact with us at KPMG Luxembourg. If you check these boxes, we want to hear from you! Here's what you need to know:

Start date: We are looking for candidates available to start in October 2027 and January 2028.

description:
Für einen internationalen Technologie- und Entertainment-Kunden in Malta suchen wir koreanischsprachige Kandidaten für eine kundenorientierte Online-Rolle in einem professionellen Studio-Umfeld.
Vorerfahrung ist nicht erforderlich – eine umfassende Schulung wird angeboten.

We are recruiting Korean-speaking Online Presenters / Customer Service Representatives for a global technology company based in Malta.

In this role, you will work from a professional studio environment, engaging with online users and delivering a high-quality, interactive digital experience. No previous experience is required — full training is provided.

Key Responsibilities

- Host and present interactive online sessions from a live studio
- Engage with users in a professional, friendly, and customer-focused manner
- Maintain high presentation and service standards at all times
- Participate in internal initiatives and promotional activities
- Follow company procedures and quality standards
- Report any operational or technical issues to supervisors
- Maintain a clean and professional working environment

Requirements

- No previous experience required – full training provided
- Fluent Korean
- Conversational English (B1 or above)
- Willingness to work a 24/7 rotating shift pattern (including weekends and public holidays)
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment

Benefits

- Competitive salary
- Up to €400 monthly performance bonus
- €400 annual wellness allowance
- Night shift allowance
- Monthly transport allowance (€70)
- Monthly food allowance
- Retention allowance
- Life insurance (2x annual salary)
- Private health insurance from day one
- Free access to on-site gym
- Company events and social activities
- Snacks and fruit provided at the workplace

Note: German language skills are not required. Relocation to Malta is supported.

Du bist die zentrale Anlaufstelle für eine Vielzahl von Anfragen rund um Kundenkonten und sorgst für ein positives Serviceerlebnis.

Diese Position wird in Vollzeit angeboten und erfordert flexible Arbeitszeiten. Um dem vollen Sportkalender gerecht zu werden, arbeitest du im Schichtsystem an fünf von sieben Tagen – Wochenend- und Feiertagsarbeit ist regelmäßig vorgesehen.

Die Stelle ist Teil eines hybriden Arbeitsmodells – du arbeitest sowohl von zu Hause als auch im modernen Büro im Zentrum von Sliema, mit Meerblick und Zugang zu zahlreichen Freizeitmöglichkeiten.

- Vollständiges Umzugspaket (Details unten)
- Attraktives Jahresbruttogehalt von ca. 34.600 €

- Lebens- und Krankenversicherung
- Kostenlose Fitnessstudio-Mitgliedschaft
- Zusätzliche 5 % deines Bruttojahresgehalts als Altersvorsorge
- Hybrides Arbeitsmodell (Homeoffice + Büro)
- Umfassende Einarbeitung und kontinuierliches Coaching
- Interne Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten

Relocation-Paket

- 6 Wochen kostenlose Unterkunft bei Ankunft
- Rückerstattung des Flugtickets (bis zu 285 €)
- 800 € monatlicher Wohnzuschuss in den ersten 6 Monaten
- Zusätzlich 100 € monatlich in den ersten 6 Monaten für Heimflüge

Deine Aufgaben

- Kundenbetreuung via Live-Chat und E-Mail
- Bearbeitung von Anfragen zu Zahlungen, Verifizierung, technischen Themen und allgemeinen Kontofragen
- Eskalation komplexer Fälle an Fachabteilungen
- Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur effizienten Problemlösung

Was du mitbringst

- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse
- Gute Englischkenntnisse (mindestens B2)
- Ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung
- Lösungsorientiertes Denken
- Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, inklusive Wochenenden

Bereit für deinen Karrierestart unter der Sonne?

Dann bewirb dich jetzt mit deinem englischen Lebenslauf – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!
