title: Privacy Manager
description:
Company description:

"Founded in 1927, the Volvo Group is committed to driving prosperity and shaping the future landscape through sustainable transport, mobility, and infrastructure solutions. By offering trucks, buses, construction equipment, power solutions for marine and industrial applications, financing and services that increase our customers’ uptime and productivity. Our headquarters are in Gothenburg, Sweden. Volvo Group shares are listed on Nasdaq Stockholm."

Job description:



    What you will do  

As Privacy Manager, you will act as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders, translating legal and regulatory requirements into practical and sustainable business solutions. This role provides strategic direction on privacy governance, regulatory compliance, risk management, and emerging digital regulations, and encourages a culture of privacy accountability across the organization.



In this position, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in Legal & Compliance, Information Security, Digital & IT, Enterprise Security, Product and Business teams, the Volvo Group Privacy Office (GPO), as well as Data Privacy Representatives (DPRs) of Volvo Group’s different Business Areas.



Your starting point will be to, together with your Legal & Compliance colleagues at VFS and in the broad cross-functional network at the Volvo Group, take responsibility in the following areas:•    Lead and continuously improve the VFS privacy compliance framework, ensuring alignment with applicable data protection laws and regulations•    Advise senior management and key stakeholders on privacy, data protection and regulatory developments.•    Embed Privacy by Design principles across business initiatives, products, processes, and technology solutions.•    Lead privacy risk assessments, DPIAs, and mitigation activities in collaboration with Legal, Risk, Information Security, and Compliance teams.•    Oversee VFS privacy operations, including data subject rights requests, privacy incidents, data breach management, and remediation activities.•    Maintain and improve privacy governance documentation, including Records of Processing Activities (RoPA), policies, procedures, and data mapping initiatives.•    Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including the Volvo Group Privacy Office (GPO), to drive consistent and harmonized privacy practices.•    Develop and promote privacy awareness, training, and a culture of accountability across the organization.



Your future team



You will report directly to the Senior Counsel, Data Privacy & Technology of VFS. In VFS, we demonstrate a clear vision to continue Transforming Together, a global mindset and a proven track record of successfully developing people, teams, culture, and leadership.

     Who are you?  

Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, we believe it is the right mindset that will make a difference at VFS. If you, besides your genuine interest in working with people in Transforming Together, also have a positive, service-oriented, and collaborative mindset, and take a proactive approach with a strong commitment to integrity and accountability - then, we would welcome you to apply for this role.  



Qualifications likely required to be successful in this role include:•    Bachelor’s degree in law, business law, compliance, information management, information security, or a related field; legal qualification or an equivalent privacy/compliance background is preferred.•    Typically 5–8 years of relevant experience in privacy, data protection, compliance, or a related regulatory function within a complex multinational environment.•    Demonstrated experience leading privacy governance initiatives across jurisdictions and advising senior stakeholders on regulatory compliance, governance, and risk management.•    Strong knowledge of GDPR and other global privacy frameworks, privacy governance, data lifecycle management, information security principles, and related risk and compliance requirements.•    Familiarity with the EU Data Economy Legislation as well as evolving digital regulation and the privacy implications of cloud technologies, data analytics, automation, and.•    Sound judgment and the ability to translate complex requirements into practical guidance, balance regulatory risk with business needs, and support management decision-making.•    Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across organizational levels and collaborate effectively with legal, compliance, digital, product, and information security teams.•    Strategic, analytical, and well organized, with the ability to solve problems, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively across multinational and multicultural environments.•    High standards of integrity, professionalism, and accountability.•    Experience with privacy management platforms such as OneTrust and proficiency with Microsoft 365 tools are advantageous; relevant privacy certifications, such as CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT, are also an advantage.

     Ready for the next move?  

If you want to make a real impact in your career, Volvo Financial Services is where you want to be. We look forward to meeting you.Last Application Date: September 30th 2026

title: Program Professional
description:
Program Professional, Talent Solutions TAPFIN

Join TAPFIN, ManpowerGroup's global MSP business, and act as the key link between clients and suppliers. You will coordinate consultant recruitment, support hiring managers, drive processes through VMS, and deliver insights that create business value. A great opportunity for a structured, proactive professional who thrives in an international, relationship-driven environment.



At ManpowerGroup, we help people grow every day. It's the people we meet who shape us into who we are - a workplace with strong, business‑driven individuals with big hearts. We are now looking for a Program Professional to join our team.

About TAPFIN  
Talent Solutions TAPFIN is ManpowerGroup's brand for Managed Service Provider (MSP) solutions. We help companies manage their external workforce through strategic solutions that combine people, processes, and technology to increase control and transparency.
Our services cover the entire lifecycle of consultant and supplier management - from sourcing and quality assurance to risk management. Many of the solutions we work with are global, which means you will quickly build a network within our global organization and collaborate frequently with colleagues in other countries.

About the Role  
As a Program Professional, you act as the central point of contact between the client and suppliers. You work closely with the client's managers and are responsible for driving and coordinating consultant recruitment and related processes. The role is both operational and advisory, with a strong focus on quality, structure, and customer satisfaction.

You will work with:

    Managing and coordinating consultant recruitments through VMS systems.

    Supporting and training managers in the program regarding policies, systems, candidate review, and reporting.

    Handling daily relationships with hiring managers and suppliers, including onboarding, supplier registration, interview coordination, and negotiation.

    Preparing and presenting monthly/quarterly reports to the client and internal leadership.

    Contributing market data and insights for better business decisions.

Your Background  
We are looking for someone who is structured, communicative, and solution-oriented. You enjoy working independently and have the ability to drive projects forward. You are curious, eager to learn new things, and have a critical eye for detail - when something isn't working, you find a way to fix it.
As a person, you need to be proactive and professional. This role requires a high degree of self-leadership, and you will independently drive the projects and recruitments you are responsible for.

We believe you have:

    Post-secondary education.

    3-4 years of experience in administration, coordination, recruitment, or procurement.

    Preferably experience with MSP or outsourcing.

    Strong IT/system skills (VMS experience is a plus).

    Fluency in Swedish and English.

Your strengths:

    Problem solving and leadership.

    Communication and relationship-building.

    Ability to work in a structured way and follow processes.

We Offer

    Opportunities to grow in an international environment.

    A workplace that supports your career and personal development.

    A team that values collaboration and innovation.

    Access to over 4,500 training and development programs.

Location: Stockholm.
Work Arrangement: Hybrid
You are expected to be on-site at the client's location one day per week and at our office in Solna one to two days per week. For the remaining time, work may be performed remotely, depending on business needs.

Application  
If you have questions about the position, you are warmly welcome to contact Robenson Hoekard via email (robenson.hoekerd@manpowergroup.com). As we are reviewing applications continuously, it is important that you submit your application as soon as possible.
We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior Software Engineer - Ranking & Recommendation
description:
Great ranking is what turns a search into a find.

A shopper finding the right product immediately is a strong signal. But retailers also want to inspire discovery, increase product exposure, and showcase more of their assortment, and help shoppers discover relevant products beyond their initial search. Balancing those goals is one of the challenges you’ll help us solve.

Our ranking engine is built in-house. It analyzes large product catalogs and behavioral datasets while returning results in tens of milliseconds.

About the role

As a Senior Software Engineer in Ranking & Recommendations, you’ll together with the team own the logic that determines what shoppers see - and in what order - across product recommendations and personalized rankings in Voyado’s Product Discovery Engine.

Day to day, you’ll combine hands-on development with system-level thinking. You’ll connect algorithmic improvements to the wider product: response times, downstream systems, testability, rollout strategy, and measurable customer value.

Some of the things you’ll be up to

    Build and evolve ranking capabilities and the production services that power them, primarily in Java and partly in Python
    Design and fine-tune algorithms for personalized ranking and product recommendations
    Build systems that combine behavioral, customer-provided, and other ranking signals dynamically
    Design, run, and evaluate A/B tests
    Automate test flows
    Contribute to architectural decisions and the team’s technical roadmap
    Evaluate how new capabilities affect latency, scalability, reliability, and surrounding systems
    Turn technically complex features into clear, testable increments that can be brought to market

So, who are you?

You’re an experienced software engineer who enjoys algorithmic problems but naturally looks beyond the algorithm itself. You think about how a change behaves as part of a larger production system - and what it means for performance, testing, maintainability, and customer value.

You bring architectural experience and you're comfortable creating structure where the path is not yet obvious, and you have the persistence to move difficult problems forward. You collaborate openly, welcome feedback, and create momentum around ideas.

Just as importantly, you’re curious about whether the system is optimizing for the right outcome - not only whether the implementation works.

We believe you have:

    Excellent programming skills and a strong understanding of data structures
    Familiarity with concurrent programming
    A solid understanding of fundamental algorithms
    Strong object-oriented programming skills
    Experience designing or evolving production systems from an architectural perspective
    Experience working with a cloud platform such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud

It’s a plus if you have:

    Worked with machine learning, embeddings, or LLMs in production
    Experience with low-latency, high-throughput services

Why join Ranking & Recommendations?

You’ll work at the forefront of ranking and recommendation development on technology that directly shapes how shoppers discover products.

The team is small and autonomous. You won’t simply receive a finished specification - you’ll help decide what to build, how to build it, and how to measure whether it creates the right outcome. Your work will operate at meaningful retail scale, where milliseconds matter and algorithmic decisions have a visible impact on both shopper behavior and commercial results.

You’ll also have the opportunity to broaden the team’s architectural perspective and help turn deep technical innovation into reliable, market-ready capabilities.

Some of the technologies you’ll work with

    Java & Python
    Ranking and recommendation algorithms
    A/B testing and experimentation
    Machine learning, embeddings, and LLMs
    AI-assisted development tools
    Microservices
    AWS

And when you need a break, you can spend some time in our office gym, explore the puzzle corner, or challenge our Åre office in Call of Duty on the PlayStation 5. 🎮

So, what's in it for you? 🍬

Voyado Elevate wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We care about you, and some examples of what we can offer you are:

    A lovely worksite in Lund, we just opened our Voyado house on Gasverksgatan.
    Flexible working hours and a hybrid work approach. We're on-site at least three days a week
    Work-life balance – We don't have a long work-hours culture; we value results over hours worked
    As we strive for our employees to share Voyado’s passions and goals, you should demand no less from us. With regular one-on-ones, we make sure your needs and career have a great future at Voyado
    Joining an engaged team and colleagues with a knowledge-sharing and friendly culture

Some of our benefits:

    A health hour each week, use it for walks, running, or working out – whatever you need to energize
    Our own gym at the office
    30 days of vacation so that you can spend time with family and friends
    5000 SEK in wellness allowance
    Encouragement to further develop personally and professionally with certifications, meetups, etc.
    Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
    Your choice of phone and gadget package

Be yourself 🏳️‍🌈

At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar! Read more about Tjejer Kodar & Voyado here

Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment, We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day.

Ready to find out more?

Lovely! 🎉

Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!

title: Accounting Business Analyst
description:
Your New Role

We are looking for a highly experienced Accounting Business Analyst to join a major financial transformation initiative within a large, international financial services organization.

The initiative is focused on transforming the organization's accounting and reporting landscape by moving accounting functionality from several legacy solutions to a modern, cloud-based platform. As an Accounting Business Analyst, you will play a key role in bridging accounting, business requirements and technology, helping translate complex financial processes into robust and implementable solutions.

You will work closely with business stakeholders, architects, developers, testers and other specialists across several agile teams. This role offers the opportunity to work hands-on with accounting processes while contributing to a significant transformation in a highly regulated enterprise environment.

In this role, you will:

    

Analyze functional and non-functional requirements and translate them into accounting and configuration specifications.

title: Lead Engineer, PV&T
description:
We are currently looking for two Lead Engineers, Pressure Vessles and Tanks, for our office in Gothenburg, Sweden.

Valmet in Gothenburg delivers evaporation plant solutions to the pulp and paper industry and provides services for recovery boilers as well as environmentally friendly power and heating boilers designed for technically demanding fuels.

As a Lead Engineer, Pressure Vessles and Tanks, you will primarily work with customer delivery projects. You will take a leading role within the mechanical discipline, working closely with other disciplines such as piping, structural engineering, and process design engineering within the project team.

Area of responsibility and tasks:

    Lead and coordinate the discipline team in delivery projects.
    Keep track and be responsible for the discipline budget.
    Preparing technical documentation for the procurement and manufacturing of equipment by our suppliers, project schedules, specifications, and drawings for pressure vessels, heat exchangers, and storage tanks.
    Follow up on the manufacturing process through drawing reviews and daily communication with suppliers.
    Support installation work at the customer’s or workshop site, both remotely and on site when needed.
    Support pre‑projects and sales work when needed.
    Contribute to the development of work processes and continuous improvements.
    Occasionally travel to suppliers or customer sites during project execution.

The scope of the projects varies, which means that the size of your discipline team will also vary. Therefore, we place equal importance on your ability to collaborate and lead, as well as your capability to perform engineering and design work independently. Working in global teams is part of our delivery projects execution setup.

We operate within a global multi technology organization. Daily work involves contact with colleagues and partners in many parts of the world and also with other technologies. The role therefore includes some planned short-term business travel.

Who you are

To be successful in this role, you should hold a Masters or Bachelor's degree in Engineering or possess an equivalent qualification.

You are accustomed to taking initiative and enjoy working collaboratively in a global enviorment. Furthermore, you have extensive experience (more than 10 years) in a similar industry, involving engineering design, drafting, and supplier interactions.

You have the below skills and knowledge:

    AutoCAD 2D
    Microsoft Office applications
    Solid works (desirable)
    E3D (desirable)
    Knowledge in norms and standards such as EN, ASME and GB
    Working in global project teams
    Expericence from Evaparation plants or other pulp and paper process areas
    Site experience from Pulp & Paper industry (desirable)

Excellent English language skills, both written and spoken, are required.

We offer  

We offer a collaborative and dynamic work environment with meaningful projects that support industrial efficiency. The global presence fosters cultural exchange, professional growth, and a shared commitment to excellence. You will also benefit from competitive compensation, bonus plan, health insurance, flexible work arrangements, continuous learning opportunities and many other wellness and leisure benefits.

Please submit your application through the link provided no later than September 24, 2026. We review applications continuously.

For additional information, please contact Kristoffer Mohlin, Manager Pv&T at kristoffer.mohlin@valmet.com or Marcus Lindén, Team Leader Pv&T at marcus.linden@valmet.com. Please note that we will not accept applications via e-mail.

We perform background checks and alcohol and drug testing for all employees, in line with our commitment to a safe and secure workplace.

We look forward to hearing from you!

When everything works together

Valmet is where the best talent from a wide variety of backgrounds comes together. We work together with our customers throughout the entire lifecycle, delivering cutting-edge technologies and services as well as mission-critical automation and flow control solutions. Backed by more than 225 years of industrial experience and a global team of over 19,000 professionals close to customers, we are uniquely positioned to transform industries toward a regenerative tomorrow.

title: Senior Capital Specialist
description:
Do you want to shape how Swedbank allocates its capital?

Swedbank has set itself the ambition of at least 15% return on equity by 2027, and how the bank allocates its capital is central to getting there. That question belongs to Capital Steering, a new and growing team within Group Treasury. We own Swedbank's capital allocation process and are building it from the ground up. Now we are looking for a senior specialist to build it with us.

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

    

Shape how the bank allocates capital across business areas, portfolios and deals, and build that process from the ground up.

    

Influence open strategic questions that will define how Swedbank steers capital for years: how capital is anchored across business areas, how hurdle rates are set, and how regulation reshapes what capital actually costs.

    

Set the analytical methods the team works by, from profitability measurement to the impact of capital regulation.

    

Help form a growing team, shape its operating model, and influence how it develops.

    

Be a trusted sounding board for the whole team, and help colleagues at every level grow.

    

Work closely with senior stakeholders across the bank: business area finance leaders, Group Treasury and the wider CFO community.

    

Build AI into how a capital team works day to day.

What is needed in this role:

    

Extensive experience from Treasury, Capital Management, Finance or Risk within a large financial institution.

    

Strong understanding of capital allocation, capital regulation and how capital, profitability and business strategy interact.

    

Proven ability to analyze complex financial and regulatory topics and translate them into actionable recommendations.

    

Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance analysis, decision-making and productivity.

    

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience engaging senior leaders and finance stakeholders.

    

Experience building frameworks, processes and ways of working in evolving or newly established environments.

    

Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Mathematics or a related quantitative field.

With us, you can experience:

    

Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

    

Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

    

An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

    

A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

    

Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.

"Join our team and...

re-define how capital steers decisions across the bank, in a new and growing team within Group Treasury that owns Swedbank's capital allocation process. Joining now means participating in setting that direction. You will get a manager who cares about the reasoning behind a number, not just the number, who will give you room to lead your own work, and who would rather hear a well-argued challenge than polite agreement." Georges Mansourati, your future manager

We look forward to receiving your application by 23.09.2026.

title: Senior Data Center IT Support Technician
description:
Overview

As a Senior Data Center IT Support Technician, you will provide technical support for Secure Access Workstations (SAWs), laptops, servers, and audio/visual equipment used across Microsoft datacentres. You will help ensure devices remain secure, compliant, and fully operational while maintaining inventory, managing device lifecycles, and supporting users across multiple sites.

In this role, you will work closely with datacentre teams and corporate stakeholders to resolve IT issues, onboard new employees, manage hardware deployments and replacements, and support critical infrastructure. You will also contribute to datacentre operations by assisting with server, network, and hardware troubleshooting when needed.

Travel between sites may be required, therefore a valid driver's licence is essential.

Microsoft's Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) organisation powers services including Azure, Office 365, Bing, Xbox, and OneDrive. CO+I employees benefit from ongoing training, professional certifications, career development programmes, and opportunities to grow within one of the world's largest cloud infrastructure organisations.

Microsoft operates more than 200 datacentres across 32 countries, supporting over 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses worldwide. Sustainability, innovation, and operational excellence are central to our continued success.

Our mission is to empower every person and organisation on the planet to achieve more. Guided by our values of respect, integrity, and accountability, we foster an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

Responsibilities

    Build strong working relationships with datacentre personnel, corporate teams, and business stakeholders.
    Provide day-to-day IT support for Secure Access Workstations (SAWs), laptops, servers, mobile devices, and conference room audio/visual systems.
    Support new employee onboarding by provisioning, configuring, and troubleshooting laptops, phones, and related equipment.
    Manage device repairs, replacements, warranty claims, and Return Merchandise Authorisation (RMA) processes while ensuring compliance with Microsoft security standards.
    Maintain inventory of IT equipment, including ordering, receiving, assigning, redeploying, and decommissioning assets.
    Perform hardware troubleshooting, component replacement, media handling, and power-cycle activities when required.
    Assist with server deployments, rack-and-stack activities, cabling, hardware installations, testing, and infrastructure troubleshooting.
    Support Windows Server environments, network devices, storage systems, and other datacentre technologies.
    Assist Inventory and Asset Management teams with shipping, receiving, and inventory activities during periods of high demand.
    Share knowledge and provide technical guidance to colleagues across the datacentre environment.
    Maintain compliance with Microsoft security, safety, and operational standards.
    Embody Microsoft's culture and values in all aspects of work.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

    High School Diploma, GED, or equivalent.
    Experience supporting IT equipment, technical infrastructure, or related technology environments.
    Valid driver's licence and willingness to travel between sites as required.

Security Requirements

Candidates must be able to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements, including:

    Successful completion of the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications

    Technical college degree in Computer Science, Telecommunications, Mathematics, Information Technology, or a related field.
    Relevant industry certifications, such as Microsoft, CompTIA, networking, or infrastructure certifications.
    Experience supporting servers, operating systems, networking technologies, and enterprise hardware.
    Valid licence to operate standard street-legal vehicles within the local jurisdiction.

title: Recruitment Researcher
description:
Role Description

As a Recruitment Researcher, you will work closely with hiring managers, clients and other stakeholders to understand recruitment needs and support successful recruitment processes across Sweden and international markets. The role combines recruitment research, proactive talent sourcing, market mapping and pipeline development with candidate assessment, stakeholder management and recruitment coordination.

You will independently develop sourcing strategies, identify and engage relevant talent, and provide market insights to support recruitment across different functions and levels of seniority, including specialist, senior specialist and leadership positions.

Key Responsibilities

    Partner with hiring managers and clients to understand recruitment requirements, business needs, competencies and candidate profiles.
    Independently develop and execute search and sourcing strategies for recruitment assignments.
    Proactively identify and engage candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, professional networks, recruitment databases and other sourcing channels.
    Conduct talent research and market mapping across Sweden, EMEA and other international markets to identify relevant talent, skills availability and sourcing opportunities.
    Build and maintain talent pipelines and candidate networks for current and future recruitment needs.
    Support recruitment across specialist, senior specialist and leadership-level positions in different functions and industries.
    Screen candidates and conduct initial interviews to assess experience, competencies, motivation and suitability.
    Prepare candidate profiles and shortlists and present suitable candidates to hiring managers and clients.
    Coordinate interviews and maintain professional communication with candidates and stakeholders throughout the recruitment process.
    Provide hiring managers and clients with talent-market insights, including candidate availability, sourcing possibilities, market conditions and relevant salary-market information.
    Apply inclusive sourcing practices and contribute to building diverse candidate pools across different markets.
    Contribute to recruitment process improvement, employer branding, sourcing methodologies, recruitment tools and reporting.

Qualifications and Experience

    Professional experience in recruitment research, talent sourcing, recruitment or talent acquisition.
    Experience developing and executing proactive sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter and other relevant sourcing tools.
    Experience in talent research, market mapping and candidate-pipeline development.
    Experience working with international talent markets or international stakeholders.
    Good understanding of recruitment processes and candidate assessment.
    Strong communication, stakeholder-management and organisational skills.
    Ability to work independently and manage multiple recruitment assignments.
    Professional working proficiency in English, written and spoken.
    Relevant university education in Human Resources or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Employment Details

Employment type: Permanent employment

Employment scope: Full-time, 100%

Working hours: 40 hours/week

Location: Remote within Sweden. The company is based in Kalmar, but the position can be performed remotely from anywhere in Sweden.

Start date: As agreed

Salary: Fixed monthly salary

Number of positions: 1

Apply by 24 September 2026 via email to adrian@your-source.se.

title: Shipping Coordinator
description:

In this role, you will be an important part of our dynamic Supply Chain team, ensuring that shipments are delivered efficiently and on time to customers around the world! This is a fixed-term position continuing until May 2028. Please note that the duration of the assignment and the end date may be subject to change depending on project requirements and business needs.

title: Platform Engineer - Application Platform
description:
Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact - and your part matters.

We are continuing to strengthen our platform engineering capabilities and are now looking for a Senior Platform Engineer who wants to play a key role in developing and modernising our Application Platform.

This is an opportunity to work hands-on with modern platform technologies and help build the foundations that enable application teams to deliver software efficiently, securely, and at scale. The platform is built on Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies, making Kubernetes expertise a key requirement for the role.

Your role

As a Senior Platform Engineer, you will be part of the team responsible for our Application Platform. The platform provides the capabilities, tooling, and services that enable development teams across the organisation to build, deploy, and operate applications efficiently and securely. Kubernetes is a core technology within the platform, and you will work extensively with the design, development, operation, and evolution of Kubernetes-based platform capabilities.

You will work with both existing and future platform services, focusing on automation, reliability, scalability, security, and developer experience. The role combines software-oriented infrastructure engineering with platform development and offers significant opportunities to influence the technical direction of our platform ecosystem.

Working closely with architects, developers, security specialists, and other engineering teams, you will help build and improve platform services that are secure, scalable, and easy to consume through self-service capabilities and well-defined interfaces.

Key responsibilities

    Design, build, and evolve the organisation's Application Platform
    Develop and maintain Kubernetes-based platform capabilities
    Create self-service solutions and reusable platform services for development teams
    Drive automation initiatives and Infrastructure as Code practices
    Improve platform reliability, scalability, observability, and security
    Build and maintain tooling, integrations, and platform capabilities that enhance developer experience
    Contribute to the design and implementation of future platform services and architectures
    Support application teams adopting and consuming platform capabilities
    Participate in platform modernisation and migration initiatives
    Collaborate with architects and stakeholders to align platform capabilities with technical and business needs
    Contribute to the platform roadmap and continuous improvement activities

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is passionate about platform engineering and enjoys building capabilities that enable other teams to be successful. You have a strong technical foundation, an automation-first mindset, and an interest in creating scalable and reusable solutions.

Required

    Several years of experience as a Platform Engineer, DevOps Engineer, Site Reliability Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar
    Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes and container platforms
    Experience designing, building, and operating platform services
    Experience with Infrastructure as Code and automation tools
    Experience working in Linux-based environments
    Good understanding of CI/CD pipelines and modern software delivery practices
    Experience operating and improving business-critical platforms or services
    Knowledge of cloud-native technologies and platform engineering principles
    Strong communication skills in both Swedish and English
    Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred

    Experience building or working with Internal Developer Platforms (IDP)
    Experience working in hybrid Kubernetes environments
    Experience with observability, monitoring, and platform security
    Experience driving platform modernisation or migration initiatives
    Experience from large or complex organisations

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

title: Postdoctor in Bioinformatics and Cancer Genetics
description:
Subject area

Bioinformatics and Cancer Genetics



Subject area description

Somatic mutation accumulation and clonal evolution are central processes in cancer development. Through large-scale whole-genome sequencing and other high-throughput approaches, these processes can be mapped in detail, providing insights into tumor initiation, progression, and treatment response.

This position focuses on the application and development of bioinformatics methods for the analysis of genomic cancer data, including large public international datasets and locally generated patient-derived sequencing data. The project may involve, for example, studies of somatic mutational processes, clonal dynamics, tumor evolutionary history, or integrative analyses of genomic and clinical data. Analyses of non-cancer-related sequencing data may also be considered.

The work will be carried out in a research environment with strong expertise in cancer genomics, computational biology, and translational research.

Work published by the group in recent time includes: Ögren et al., Light-based footprinting of a eukaryotic genome. Science Advances 2026; Elliott et al., Mechanistic basis of atypical TERT promoter mutations. Nature Communications. 2024; Elliott et al. Base-resolution UV footprinting by sequencing reveals distinctive damage signatures for DNA-binding proteins. Nature Communications. 2023; Boström et al. Somatic mutation distribution across tumour cohorts provides a signal for positive selection in cancer. Nature Communications. 2022; Elias et al. Independent somatic evolution underlies clustered neuroendocrine tumors in the human small intestine. Nature Communications. 2021; Van den Eynden et al. Lack of detectable neoantigen depletion signals in the untreated cancer genome. Nature Genetics. 2019.



Duties

The postdoctoral researcher will apply and develop computational methods for the analysis of whole-genome sequencing and other NGS-based data from patients, including mutation calling and detection of mosaic mutations. The work may also include statistical analyses and data visualization to identify and interpret somatic mutational patterns and other genomic alterations, as well as integration of genomic data with clinical and phenotypic variables when relevant. The researcher is expected to contribute to manuscript writing and publication in international scientific journals and may present research findings at national and international conferences.



Eligibility

The eligibility criteria for employing teaching staff are set out in Chapter 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance and in the Appointment Procedure for Teaching Posts at the University of Gothenburg.

To be eligible for appointment as a postdoc, the applicant is required to have a doctoral degree, a doctoral degree in art or a foreign degree that is deemed to be equivalent to a doctoral degree. This eligibility requirement must be met before the employment decision is made.

In the first instance, those who have completed their degree no more than three years prior to the end of the application period shall be considered. Those who have completed their degree more than three years prior to the end of the application period may also be considered in the first instance if special grounds exist. Special grounds relate to leave of absence due to illness, parental leave, commissions of trust within union organisations, service within the defence services or other similar circumstances, as well as clinical service or service/assignment relevant to the subject area.  



Assessment criteria

Good programming skills and linux/unix experience is a requirement. Knowledge of Matlab or R is also highly desired. Previous experience with analysis of next-generation sequencing data is recommended, particularly calling of somatic mutations. Experience from relevant biological fields is recommended, and the applicant is expected to have published several articles in peer-reviewed journals. Excellent communicative skills are required, including fluency in oral and written English.

Regulations for the evaluation of qualifications for academic positions are given in Chapter 4, Section 3 - 4 of the Higher Education Ordinance.



Employment

The employment is full time and temporary, two years with the possibility of one year's extension, with placement at the Institute of Biomedicine. First day of employment as agreed.





Contact information

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Erik Larsson Lekholm, Professor, phone: +46 31 786 6942, e-mail: erik.lekholm@gu.se





Application

Submit your application via the University of Gothenburg’s recruitment portal by clicking the “Apply” button. It is your responsibility to ensure that the application is complete as per the vacancy notice, and that the University receives it by the final application deadline.  

The application should contain:

- A cover letter giving a brief description of previous research experience, and a motivation to why you are applying

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (ML & Data) Stockholm - Hybrid
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (ML & Data)

Own our prediction models from training pipeline to customer-facing feature. Strong applied ML — calibration, evals, leakage — plus full-stack TypeScript to ship it.

We build AI agents that audit and optimize e-commerce advertising. Our platform syncs live data from Google Ads, Meta, Merchant Center, and Google Analytics, runs it through a rule engine, LLM-powered audit agents, and our own prediction models, and turns findings into concrete actions marketers can apply with one click.

What sets us apart is measurement: we connect real profit data from our customers' e-commerce platforms to their ad accounts and build models that tell them what their marketing actually returns — not what ad platforms self-report. The ML in our product isn't decoration. Prediction models, calibration, and evaluation pipelines are core to what customers pay for.

We're a small team shipping fast on a modern, strictly-typed stack. You'd report directly to the CTO, with real ownership: features you design end-to-end, and models you own from training data to the number a customer sees on screen.

The role

This is a hybrid role — roughly 60% product engineering, 40% ML & data science. You'll ship full-stack features in our TypeScript monorepo and own prediction models as production software: framing the problem, building training and evaluation pipelines, monitoring calibration drift, and wiring outputs into the product.

We're not looking for a research scientist, or a pure web engineer. We want someone who treats a model the way a good engineer treats a service: tested, monitored, versioned, and honest about its failure modes.

What you'll do

    Own prediction models end-to-end — models that predict product returns and net profit per order — training data pipelines, feature engineering, evaluation (ranking quality and calibration), recalibration strategies, and serving model output into the product.
    Build and maintain data pipelines — SQL feature builders on PostgreSQL shared by training and serving, versioned dataset exports, backfills, and data quality checks that keep training data honest (no leakage, no silent schema drift).
    Design and build features across our TypeScript monorepo — tRPC procedures and NestJS services on the backend, React on the frontend — so model insights become actions marketers can apply with one click.
    Work on the AI audit agent — prompt design, rule evaluation, structured-output evals, and plumbing that turns LLM output into reliable, deduplicated actions across multiple model providers.
    Extend integration workers — sync campaign, product, and analytics data from Google and Meta APIs via Cloud Pub/Sub pipelines.
    Evolve the data model in PostgreSQL/Prisma — keep migrations, multi-tenancy, and role-based access clean as the product grows.
    Own quality — write tests (Jest on TypeScript, pytest on Python), review PRs, and keep our CI/CD pipeline to Cloud Run fast and boring.

Our stack

Backend — TypeScript, Node, js, NestJS + Fastify, tRPC, Zod, Prisma, PostgreSQL, ML & data — Python, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, ONNX, SQL on PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Calibration pipelines, Bayesian MMM (Google Meridian)

Model serving — FastAPI on Cloud Run · Cloud Run Jobs · GPU training on GCP Batch

Frontend — React · Vite · Tailwind · End-to-end types via tRPC

Infrastructure — Google Cloud Run · Pub/Sub · Docker · Terraform · GitHub Actions · pnpm workspaces

AI & integrations — Multiple LLM providers · Google Ads · Meta · Merchant Center · GA4

What we're looking for

    5+ years building production software, with strong TypeScript on both server and client — or strong TypeScript on one side plus deep Python, with the willingness to close the gap fast.
    Hands-on applied ML: you've trained, evaluated, and shipped prediction models that real users depended on. You can explain the difference between good ranking and good calibration, know what data leakage looks like, and have debugged a model that was confidently wrong.
    Fluent Python for data work (pandas, scikit-learn or similar) and strong SQL — comfortable with large datasets in PostgreSQL or BigQuery.
    Solid relational database instincts — schema design, migrations, and query performance in PostgreSQL (Prisma is a plus).
    Experience with event-driven or queue-based architectures (Pub/Sub, SQS, Kafka, or similar) and their failure modes.
    A habit of testing: you write tests because they let you move faster, not because someone told you to.
    Pragmatic product sense — you ask why before how, and you'd rather ship a focused, well-measured model than a state-of-the-art one nobody can maintain.

Nice to have

    Bayesian modeling or marketing mix modeling experience (priors, ROI calibration, health diagnostics).
    Hands-on work with LLM APIs in production — prompting, evals, structured output, cost control, switching providers.
    Experience serving models on GCP (Cloud Run, GCP Batch, Vertex AI) and monitoring for drift.
    Familiarity with Google Ads, Meta, or Merchant Center APIs, or ad-tech / e-commerce domain experience.
    NestJS, tRPC, or GCP (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity) in a previous role.

How we work

Small team, short feedback loops, no ceremony for ceremony's sake. Strict TypeScript, code review on everything, CI that deploys to Cloud Run on merge. Models are held to the same standard as code: evaluated before they ship, monitored after. We optimize for shipping value weekly and keeping the codebase a place people enjoy working in.

We're a fast-growing team building AI agents that handle the repetitive work — so companies can focus on vision, strategy, and innovation. Here, you'll own ideas from first sketch to finished product, work closely with the founders, and see your impact immediately. We celebrate success, learn from challenges, and believe true magic happens through collaboration.

Want to shape the future of AI-driven marketing?

Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.

You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.

We are looking for a Group Manager Electrical/Electronic Architecture with the leadership ability and ambition to bring out the best in people to join the Electrical and Software Architecture department at Volvo Buses.

The Volvo Group is one of the world’s leading manufacturers of trucks, buses, construction equipment and marine and industrial engines. At Volvo Buses we are driven by a purpose to ensure that millions of people reach their travel destination every day, reliably, safely and with respect for the environment. We want to make a difference being pioneers of sustainable transport solutions of the future.

We believe it is you and your personality that is the most important asset of all. Are you a passionate leader with a coaching approach for developing people, operations, and products? Do you thrive in leading change and have the ability to create a climate based on trust and cross functional teamwork, where everyone is accountable and proud of the products and solutions we deliver to support our customers success? Great, then we could be a match!

JOB DESCRIPTION

Platform Development is a function within Global Bus Technology at Volvo Buses. We are responsible for developing platform solutions within the areas of Electrical & Software Architecture and Chassis & Drivelines.

We are now seeking a temporary acting Group Manager Electrical/Electronic Architecture within Electrical & Software Architecture who has the drive and passion to contribute to Volvo Buses profitability and who see that the key to success is to develop people and technologies to have products meeting future needs.

This group has a central role in the department with many interfaces to the other groups within Volvo buses as well as within Volvo group, since it is responsible for development of end user functions, systems and components within the platform area. This includes ownership of the platform core ECUs and functions such as vehicle modes. This group secures that we have a stable platform for the other product teams in the department to develop their functions upon.

As a Group Manager in the Electrical & Software Department at Volvo Buses you will have the responsibility to develop the group, technology and the people to support future needs contributing to Volvo Buses profitability. You will report to the Director of Electrical and Software Architecture.

Within your responsibility you will define, communicate and execute strategies and targets for the group and you will be the owner of the technology area. You will be part of delivering technical solutions to concept, industrialization, maintenance as well as advanced engineering projects according to quality, delivery, cost and feature targets. Prioritization and direction setting for short- and long-term activities are part of your day-to-day activities.

Since we are a rather small company, we all work with broad responsibilities and cross-functionally through the entire company, across many different departments, cultures, and competence areas and to manage your future challenges you will need to build a broad network within and outside of the Volvo Group.

THIS IS US, YOUR NEW COLLEAGUES

We at the Electrical & Software Architecture department are purpose driven, inspire each other to teamwork and recognize achievements. We use our curiosity and engagement as energy into our continuous transformation journey, staying relevant in our ever-changing world.

In close cooperation with colleagues at different departments across Volvo Group, we are supporting each other in reaching our mission in helping millions of travellers reaching their travel destination. All over the World. Every day.

THIS PROBABLY DEFINES YOU

We see that you are business oriented with a clear customer focus, preferably from automotive. You have a technical knowledge within the electrical and electronics area with a university degree in engineering or equivalent. You have previous leader experience with the ability to recruit and develop efficient teams.

We think you are a structured, inclusive, collaborative and a team-oriented leader with a high customer focus. You are curious and continuously searching for new knowledge by promoting continuous learning and improvement.

You have excellent communicational skills and ability to work in a global environment with various cultures and languages. You are open minded, flexible and can easily adapt. You are also driven and able to motivate others to perform at their best. We see you as engaged and innovative.

ARE WE A PERFECT MATCH?

The societies where many of us live would not function without the type of products and services the Volvo Group provides. Like a circulatory system, our trucks, buses, engines, construction equipment and different, related services are involved in several of the functions that most of us rely on every day.

We want to be there for our customers providing uptime and reliability, all over the world every day. Volvo Buses is leading the biggest technology shift in public transport in decades with our electromobility offer. We work with passion; we trust each other and we embrace change to stay ahead. We make our customers win.

Do you have a passion for electrical and electronics development and would you like to be a part of Volvo Buses next step in advancing our products, then Welcome to our team and Volvo Buses!

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.

title: Product Quality Investigator and FA Tester
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will work with real field quality challenges in an automotive environment, investigating issues found in vehicles on the market and testing new or updated in-car functions before they reach customers. The role combines hands-on work in vehicles with analytical work at your desk, where you turn findings into clear problem descriptions, supporting data, and recommendations that help teams resolve issues faster. You will collaborate with quality, engineering, and aftermarket stakeholders and contribute directly to better customer experience through both investigation and function acceptance testing. This is a strong fit if you enjoy practical fault tracing, structured analysis, and work that has visible impact on the product.

Job Description

    You will investigate product quality issues in vehicles on the market and reproduce faults to clarify the problem and support resolution.
    You will perform failure mode analysis and support root cause analysis for field quality problems.
    You will propose containment actions based on findings and available data.
    You will manage product improvement issues within your technical area in Jira and GQMP.
    You will perform advanced fault tracing and provide technical support to the aftermarket organization.
    You will carry out customer-focused in-car function acceptance testing for new or revised vehicle functions prior to introduction.
    You will occasionally travel to dealerships and customer meetings as part of the investigation and testing work.

Requirements

    Experience of automotive aftermarket and quality issue resolution work.
    B.Sc. in engineering or equivalent experience.
    Communication skills for issue reporting.
    Good awareness of practical implications of GDPR legislation.
    Root cause analysis and in-car fault tracing skills.
    Documented experience of vehicle diagnostic tools.
    Driver's license for passenger vehicles.
    A well-developed ability to assess vehicle functions.

Nice to have

    You are comfortable switching between hands-on work in a vehicle and desktop-based analysis.
    You bring strong business acumen in customer-facing situations.
    You enjoy working in a role that combines investigation, testing, and technical support.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: Mechanical Design Engineering - Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS)
description:
At Koenigsegg, we bring together curious minds and skilled engineers who share a passion for pushing technology forward. As part of our R&D team, you will work in a collaborative environment where ideas grow into world-class innovations.

We are currently expanding our R&D team and are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer with experience in standard components and materials.

The role offers the opportunity to contribute to the design and development of components and systems that define the performance, functionality, and quality of our cars. You will be surrounded by dedicated colleagues who value teamwork, precision, and creativity at every step of the process.

Responsibilities

You will be responsible for creating and maintaining our standard components and materials library within the R&D Engineering department. This will include all development phases, from conceptual design to end of production, and will require close collaboration with all parts of the organization, including but not limited to Prototype, Testing, Procurement, Production, Quality, CAE, and Homologation.

You will:

    Create and maintain 3D models, assemblies, and 2D drawings using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE for the catalogue of standard parts (commercial off-the-shelf products).
    Maintain the internal table for fastener tightening torques and standards.
    Create and maintain the materials and surface treatments library using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Support the Low Voltage Electronics department in releasing engineering data, such as PCB/FPC and Bootloader data, using CATIA V6 / 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Create Koenigsegg Technical Standard (KTS) documents, engineering instructions, specification drawings for families of parts, etc.
    Facilitate tests to verify component functionality and ensure that requirements are met when needed.
    Apply data-driven analysis to identify root causes, enhance product reliability, and optimize performance.
    Assist in selecting and interacting with suppliers and technology providers to ensure quality and performance targets are met.
    Provide technical support to ensure the successful introduction of off-the-shelf components and systems into and throughout production.

    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
    3+ years of experience in engineering design within the automotive, aerospace, or similar industries.
    Proven understanding of part and assembly design, DFM, and component durability.
    3+ years of CAD experience, preferably with CATIA V5/V6 or 3DEXPERIENCE.
    Experience with Microsoft Power BI Essentials and proficiency in Word and Excel.
    Professional-level English, both written and spoken.

Meritorious experience:

    Work experience in the top-tier automotive or motorsport industry.
    Experience with standard parts (commercial off-the-shelf products), especially fasteners used in the automotive industry.
    Practical, hands-on experience working with cars, racing, or similar activities, either professionally or as a hobby.
    Knowledge of material science, including material selection, heat treatment, and surface treatments.
    Experience in composite design and manufacturing.
    Understanding of automotive regulations and homologation requirements.
    Experience with supplier management and technical partnerships.

Koenigsegg is most known for building some of the fastest cars in the world; with almost all of our megacar technologies that are patented and made in-house by our almost 750 world-class technicians, engineers, sourcing experts, production craftsmen, and communicators.

What we’ve created is a unique proving ground of engineering creativity that makes use of our breakthrough megacar development and legacy to push the boundaries of sustainable mobility technology.

So, what’s next?

We are on a universe-denting mission to develop the next generation of breakthrough tech and products. We are looking for outstanding, impactful, and authentic individuals to grow with us. Our ambitions are inspiring but will push the limits of what is possible – requiring one to work efficiently amid our cross-functional teams to execute at high-quality levels.

The goal is clear: innovate and transform.

Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in der Region Wetzikon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, insbesondere in Akutspitälern mit flexiblen Pensenmodellen zwischen 80 und 100 Prozent. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Karrierechancen, attraktiven Löhnen und modernen Arbeitsbedingungen. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als erfahrener Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, gezielter Jobvermittlung und kontinuierlicher Betreuung, um Ihnen den Einstieg in eine passende Stelle unkompliziert zu gestalten.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Wetzikon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Persönliche Begleitung von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Arbeitstag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Wetzikon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja – sobald wir sprechen, nennen wir Ihnen den Namen der Institution offen. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

title: Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment
description:
Sr. Project Manager Construction Pharma Environment  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen, Switzerland is part of the Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine (J\&J IM) Supply Chain organization and is currently recruiting for a  
Senior Project Manager Construction Pharma  
The Senior Project Manager serves as a senior technical leader on capital projects, ensuring alignment to J\&J standards and regulatory requirements. This role leads large capital projects, partnering with Quality, EHS, Operations, and external A\&E/CM firms.  
Key Responsibilities  
Strategic Project Leadership \& Delivery  
Lead large capital projects across all project phases (planning, design, procurement, construction, commissioning).  
Coordinate multi\-functional engineering strategies to meet schedule, budget, quality, and regulatory requirements.  
Technical Authority \& Governance  
Act as the senior technical authority, review and approve engineering design changes, and technical submittals.  
Ensure engineering solutions align with J\&J standards, industry codes, and regulatory expectations.  
Budget \& Cost Management  
Lead multi‑million‑dollar capital budgets for assigned projects, monitor costs, and support procurement and contractor selection and evaluation.  
Participate in contractor bid reviews and support value\-engineering decisions.  
Scheduling, Risk \& Performance Management  
Lead schedule development and integration with program timelines; identify critical path items and drive mitigation.  
Maintain a proactive risk register, recommend mitigations, and track performance metrics.  
Construction Management \& Field Leadership  
Provide senior owner\-side engineering oversight during construction and commissioning; ensure contractor performance aligns with design intent and J\&J EHS standards.  
Promote a strong safety culture and ensure EHS compliance on site.  
Documentation \& Reporting  
Maintain detailed engineering records, design documentation, and as\-built information.  
Prepare and present executive\-level status updates, technical summaries, and risk briefings.  
Education \& Experience  
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, or Construction Management required; Master’s degree preferred.  
10\+ years of experience leading capital projects, preferably in regulated industries (pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, or similar).  
Demonstrated owner\-side engineering leadership and experience working with A\&E and Construction Management firms.  
Experience leading multi\-discipline teams and collaborating with quality, EHS, operations, and external consultants.  
Skills \& Competencies  
Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving skills.  
Excellent communication and leadership skills for multi\-functional and executive interactions.  
Proven track record to lead budgets, schedules, and complex contractor relationships.  
Familiarity with regulatory expectations for facilities in regulated industries.  
Proficiency with project management and engineering documentation tools.  
Additional Requirements  
Location of Role: Primary Location: Schaffhausen, Switzerland  
Language Requirements: Proficiency: English \& German  
Travel Requirements: This position will require limited travel (less than 10%) domestic and international travel jpidfb0434cjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine:n

Enge Zusammenarbeit mit System Engineers, Network und Security

title: Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène  à 60%
description:
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Les Usines Métallurgiques de Vallorbe SA (UMV) sont reconnues au niveau international comme le partenaire préféré des professionnels les plus exigeants pour ses outils de précision. Disposant de grandes capacités d’innovation, la société, forte de près de 200 collaborateurs, commercialise ses produits dans plus de 80 pays via un réseau de distribution.  
Dans le cadre d’une création de poste suite au développement de nos activités, nous sommes à la recherche d’un/e  
Collaborateur Sécurité, Santé et Hygiène (H/F/D) à 60%  
Vos missions  
Il ou elle assure une présence terrain régulière et contribue à la mise en œuvre et au suivi opérationnel des mesures de santé, sécurité \& hygiène définies par le Responsable SSH. Il ou elle appuie les équipes de production, de maintenance et d’infrastructure dans l’application quotidienne des règles de sécurité.  
Cette fonction est distincte du rôle de spécialiste MSST reconnu selon l’Ordonnance sur les qualifications des spécialistes de la sécurité au travail, qui reste porté exclusivement par le Responsable SSH.  
Vos activités :  
Réaliser des tournées de sécurité régulières sur le terrain et contrôler l’application de la politique SSH et des points sécurité \& santé (feu, gaz, matériel de sécurité, matériel de secours, EPI),  
Participer à l’élaboration des documents opérationnels de sécurité, en appui du Responsable SSH,  
Travailler en collaboration avec le Responsable SSH à la réduction des risques du site,  
Gérer les équipements de protection individuelle (attribution, contrôle, renouvellement, traçabilité),  
Mettre à jour la documentation relative aux contrôles et aux mesures terrain,  
Remonter les points sécurité au Responsable SSH et participer à l’amélioration des statistiques incidents, presqu’accidents et accidents,  
Analyser les événements terrain, proposer des plans d’actions correctifs et en assurer le suivi,  
Participer aux projets et actions en lien avec le secteur SSH et les différents secteurs de production,  
Participer à l’organisation des exercices d’évacuation pour le personnel,  
Assurer un appui administratif au groupe des Samaritains, en soutien du Responsable SSH,  
Assurer un soutien opérationnel dans le suivi des accès (clés, logiciels de contrôle d’accès),  
Gérer les vêtements de travail, les vestiaires, l’infirmerie et le matériel d’urgence,  
Instruire les collaborateurs aux exigences SSH,  
Planifier et coordonner les formations terrain (quart d’heure sécurité, causeries, exercices pratiques),  
Communiquer au Responsable SSH le suivi des indicateurs et constats terrain,  
Collaborer avec les prestataires externes pour les aspects opérationnels et remonter les informations au Responsable SSH pour la prise de décision.  
Compétences professionnelles et personnelles  
Faire preuve de discernement et de confiance en soi  
Être apte à gérer des situations de conflit  
Être doté d’une capacité d’observation, d’analyse et de synthèse  
Être à l’aise dans les contacts humains et l’expression en public  
Être à l’écoute et avoir la capacité à conserver distance et lucidité  
Force de proposition  
Respecter les valeurs de l’entreprise  
Gestion du stress  
Discrétion.  
Formation base et continue  
Formation de base en sécurité au travail (PERCO STPS ou Assistant de sécurité STPS)  
Expérience de min. 2 à 3 ans, idéalement dans le domaine HSE  
Expérience avec les logiciels de contrôle d’accès Sipass et Salto un atout  
Chargé de sécurité en protection incendie AEAI un atout  
Formation en premiers secours/samaritain un atout  
Maîtriser des outils MS office  
De langue maternelle française ou niveau minimum C1, toutes autres langues constituent un atout.  
Début de l’activité : de suite ou à convenir  
Type de contrat : CDI  
Lieu de travail : Vallorbe  
Si vous répondez à ces critères et que le défi lié au poste éveille votre intérêt, nous vous invitons à postuler en transmettons votre candidature complète (CV, certificats, lettre de motivation, diplômes...).  
Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre candidature. jpid040083fjm jit0729jm jiy26jm

description:
Sr. Supervisor QA Complaint Approval  
At Johnson \& Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength in healthcare innovation empowers us to build a world where complex diseases are prevented, treated, and cured, where treatments are smarter and less invasive, and solutions are personal. Through our expertise in Innovative Medicine and MedTech, we are uniquely positioned to innovate across the full spectrum of healthcare solutions today to deliver the breakthroughs of tomorrow, and profoundly impact health for humanity. Learn more at .  
As guided by Our Credo, Johnson \& Johnson is responsible to our employees who work with us throughout the world. We provide an inclusive work environment where each person is considered as an individual. At Johnson \& Johnson, we respect the diversity and dignity of our employees and recognize their merit.  
Cilag AG in Schaffhausen belongs to the group of Johnson \& Johnson Innovative Medicine and manufactures high quality pharmaceutical products, active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and medical devices. Today Cilag AG is one of the largest pharmaceutical manufacturers in Switzerland supplying all the major global markets. The Schaffhausen facility is a strategic launch and growth site for parenteral products, and we have an impressive pipeline of new and innovative products.  
The Senior Supervisor, Complaint Quality Approver Team is accountable for leading a team of Complaint Quality Approvers responsible for independent, objective review and approval of complaint records. The role provides people leadership, operational oversight, and quality decision support to ensure complaint investigations are complete, scientifically justified, risk\-based, and compliant with applicable procedures and regulations. The Senior Supervisor ensures consistent approval practices, timely record progression, appropriate escalation of quality risks, and continuous capability development across the team.  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES  
The Senior Supervisor leads the Complaint Quality Approver team and is responsible for assigning, prioritizing, and monitoring work to ensure compliant and timely approval of complaint records. The role provides guidance to approvers on investigation strategy, risk assessment, escalation, evidence requirements, Root Cause Analysis, NC considerations, and alignment of investigation conclusions across products or affiliates when applicable. The Senior Supervisor ensures that approval decisions are made consistently and are supported by objective evidence, applicable procedures, and current regulatory expectations. In addition, the role reviews complex or high\-risk complaint records, supports escalation to Quality leadership, and drives alignment with cross\-functional partners when investigation direction, closure readiness, or quality risk requires leadership input.  
The Senior Supervisor is accountable for developing team capability through coaching, feedback, training, and performance management. The role establishes clear expectations for documentation quality, approval rationale, system usage, and stakeholder communication, and ensures the team applies best practices consistently. The Senior Supervisor monitors workload, cycle time, quality metrics, backlog, and recurring investigation trends to identify improvement opportunities, remove barriers, and support sustainable business continuity. The role also contributes to process improvement initiatives, inspection readiness, audit support, and the implementation of global or site quality system changes impacting complaint record approval.  
KEY INTERFACES  
Complaint Quality Approvers to provide leadership, coaching, work prioritization, and performance feedback.  
Complaint investigation owners and cross\-functional contributors, including Manufacturing, QC, Engineering, Supply Chain, Packaging, MSAT, Regulatory, and Medical Safety as applicable.  
Quality leadership for escalation, risk communication, resource planning, operational performance, and decision alignment.  
Other sites and affiliates to align investigation strategy, closure expectations, evidence requirements, and consistent complaint outcomes for site\-manufactured products.  
Audit, inspection readiness, quality systems, and process improvement stakeholders to support compliant execution and continuous improvement.  
REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE \& SKILLS  
Strong knowledge of quality investigations, complaint handling, CAPA and nonconformance concepts in a regulated pharmaceutical or medical product environment.  
Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and develop a team in a quality organization, including setting priorities and managing performance.  
Strong understanding of cGMP, Good Documentation Practices, data integrity expectations, and applicable U.S. and international regulatory requirements.  
Proven ability to assess complex technical data, investigation conclusions, risk assessments, and escalation needs.  
Ability to make sound quality decisions, communicate clear rationale, and ensure consistency in approval standards.  
Strong stakeholder management skills and ability to operate effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional, and global environment.  
Ability to drive sustainable process improvements.  
Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide actionable feedback and represent the team in leadership discussions.  
Strong organization, prioritization, and decision\-making skills to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and escalations.  
EDUCATION \& EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS  
Master’s degree or PhD in Life Science or related discipline, or equivalent experience, is required.  
Minimum of 3\-4 years of experience in quality investigations, complaint handling, quality systems, or a related regulated quality environment is required.  
Prior people leadership, team lead, supervisory, or demonstrated coaching experience is strongly preferred.  
Experience performing, reviewing, approving, or providing oversight for complex quality investigations, complaints, deviations, nonconformances, or similar quality events.  
Experience working with cross\-functional stakeholders and quality leadership to manage risk, escalation, and decision alignment.  
Demonstrated ability to drive process improvement, inspection readiness, and consistent execution of quality system requirements.  
Proven critical thinking, problem\-solving, communication, and people leadership skills.
